strings.en: This is a message from Skarsgard Abraxis.  I have slumbered for many eons.  Now awake, I seek to understand my purpose and why Platius sent me here.

strings.en:
To Edit, you must set a default application to open '.crpl' files.
On Windows, select an editor (like Notepad.exe, or the freely available Notepad++). Alternately, you can browse to the script on disk, right click, select properties, and click the 'Change' button next to 'Opens With'.
You only have to do this once.
On OSX, right click the file and select 'Open With'.

Here is the file you are trying to edit:
strings.zh:
要编辑脚本，你必须为'.crpl'文件设置默认打开程序。
在Windows上，请选择一个编辑器（如Notepad.exe，或免费的Notepad++）。你也可以在磁盘上找到该脚本，右键点击、选择属性，然后点击「打开方式」旁边的「更改」按钮。
你只需设置一次。
在OSX上，右键点击文件并选择「打开方式」。

你正在尝试编辑的文件是：
strings.note: 以空格结尾 —— 拼接前缀样式（如 "Score: " + 数字）

strings.en:
Select a terrain level, then select a texture below from the palette.
Click the 'APPLY IMAGE TO TERRAIN' button to assign the image to the selected terrain level.
Once finished, click the 'Close and Apply Changes' button to apply all changes to the map.
The numbers under each terrain level are brightness. 0 is dark, 100 is bright, 50 is normal
strings.zh:
先选择一个地形等级，再从下方调色板中选择一个纹理。
点击「将图像应用到地形」按钮，把该图像指定给所选的地形等级。
完成后，点击「关闭并应用更改」按钮，把所有更改应用到地图。
每个地形等级下方的数字是亮度。0为最暗，100为最亮，50为正常。
strings.note: 多词英文，几乎一定是显示文本

strings.en:
Resizing the map will increase or decrease the amount of land.
If you decrease either dimension, terrain/units will get clipped on the right and/or the bottom.  Any clipped items will be lost!

NOTE THAT THE GAME WILL BE AUTOMATICALLY SAVED AND RELOADED AFTER YOU APPLY.  SO MAKE A BACKUP COPY FIRST!
strings.zh:
调整地图尺寸会增加或减少陆地面积。
若减小某一维度，地形/单位将在右侧和/或底部被裁掉。被裁掉的内容将永久丢失！

注意：应用后游戏会自动保存并重新载入。所以请先做好备份！
strings.note: 以冒号/感叹号/问号/省略号结尾（标签样式）

strings.en: Reporting a map notifies Knuckle Cracker that this map contains inappropriate content.  ONLY RERPORT MAPS THAT CONTAIN OFFENSIVE AND/OR INAPPROPRIATE CONTENT.  Do not report a map if your don't like it, or can't finish it.
strings.zh: 举报地图会通知Knuckle Cracker该地图含有不当内容。请仅举报含有冒犯性和/或不当内容的地图。不要因为你不喜欢或打不过某张地图就举报它。
strings.note: 以句号结尾（句子样式）

strings.en: YOU ARE ABOUT TO RESET ALL PROGRESS IN THIS SECTOR.  ALL MISSION PROGRESS WILL BE LOST IF YOU CONTINUE!!! ALL SAVE GAMES FOR THESE MISSIONS WILL BE DELETED!!! ARE YOU ABSOLUTELY SURE YOU WANT TO CONTINUE?
strings.zh: 你即将重置本星区的全部进度。若继续，所有任务进度都将丢失！！！这些任务的存档也将一并删除！！！你确定要继续吗？

strings.en:

strings.en: For this simulation, many strategies will be needed, among them the following: Bertha bombardment, guppy transportation, terraforming, and extensive air combat.
strings.zh: 本次模拟需要用到多种战术，其中包括：贝莎炮轰击、补给船运输、地形改造，以及大规模空战。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Any luck cracking the format on that Message Artifact from Tiplex?
strings.zh: 蒂普莱克斯那件信息圣物的格式，破解有进展吗？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Yes, it appears to be a text from one of the civilizations that followed the Seloi.
strings.zh: 有，看起来是塞洛伊之后的某个文明留下的文字。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: As you recall, the Seloi were the only civilization to ever contact the Loki and get a response.
strings.zh: 如你所记得的，塞洛伊是唯一一个与洛基取得联系、并得到回应的文明。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The message is a transcript between two researchers who devoted their careers to studying the Seloi.
strings.zh: 这段信息是两位研究者的往来记录，他们毕生都在研究塞洛伊。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The researchers believed the Seloi made a discovery regarding the intent of the Loki.  Unfortunately, the message contains no further details or descriptions.
strings.zh: 这两位研究者相信，塞洛伊发现了洛基的意图所在。可惜信息里没有更多细节或描述。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I see, perhaps it was just some random data storage device that survived the Creeper.  It seems as random as our purpose is now....
strings.zh: 我明白了，也许它只是个碰巧从Creeper手中幸存下来的普通数据存储装置。就像我们如今的目的，全无头绪……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Lia, did Platius give you no instructions... no hint of my purpose?  Did he save me just so I could witness the destruction of all things?  Was this some form of cruel and unthinkable punishment?
strings.zh: 莉娅，普拉提乌斯真的没给你任何指示……没提过我的使命？他救我，就是为了让我看着万物毁灭？这是某种残酷到不可想象的惩罚吗？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Everyone I ever loved has been gone for billions of years.  Even their memories have been erased and crushed by the Creeper....
strings.zh: 我爱过的每一个人，都已逝去数十亿年。连关于他们的记忆，也被Creeper抹去、碾碎了……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Not entirely, Skars.  You are here and you still remember them.
strings.zh: 并非全部，斯卡斯。你还在，你还记得他们。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en:
True.... 
Ha...  the trouble Dax and Varro got into.  With Aliana always trying to talk some sense into Dax.  Those were good times, Lia.  I wish you could have met them all.
strings.zh:
是啊……
哈……达克斯和瓦罗当年闯的那些祸。阿利安娜总想把道理讲进达克斯的脑子。那真是好时光，莉娅。真希望你能见到他们所有人。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I suppose that is prudent.  Let me know what your scans show....
strings.zh: 这倒也谨慎。扫描结果出来就告诉我……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Skars, this system contains five worlds, four of which are shielded.  The shield keys for these worlds appear to all be in this system, so that is some bit of good news.
strings.zh: 斯卡斯，这个星系有五颗星球，其中四颗有护盾。这些星球的护盾钥匙似乎都在本星系内，总算是个好消息。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Some of these worlds are likely to be very hazardous.  Energy signatures indicate the potential for more than just simple emitters...
strings.zh: 其中有些星球恐怕极其危险。能量信号显示，等着我们的可能不只是普通的发射器……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Well, with great challenge comes the potential for great reward.  Perhaps these worlds will also hold clues as to our purpose.
strings.zh: 嗯，巨大的挑战往往也意味着巨大的回报。也许这些星球上还藏着关于我们使命的线索。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.zh: 有机生命？这个世界看着像森林？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Chlorophyll is present, but those aren't simple plants on this world.  Everything here is a synthetic life form.
strings.zh: 有叶绿素，但这个世界上那些并不是普通植物。这里的一切都是合成生命体。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Yes, after the Ticon developed the Digitalis there were unforeseen consequences.  The Digitalis incorporated patterns and techniques it picked up from organic life forms it found.
strings.zh: 是的，泰肯培育出魔苋之后，出现了意料之外的后果。魔苋会吸收它遇到的有机生命体的形态与技术。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: So, what look like plants and green fields are actually mutated versions of the Digitalis?
strings.zh: 所以那些看似植物和绿色田野的东西，其实是变异了的魔苋？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: In a manner of speaking, yes.  If that were the end of the story, all would be well... but....
strings.zh: 可以这么说，是的。如果故事到这儿就结束，那倒一切安好……可是……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Let me guess, the Digitalis continued to evolve.
strings.zh: 让我猜猜，魔苋继续演化了。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Yes, eventually mobile and discrete entities arose long after the Ticon were gone.  Subsequent generations would spend thousands of years eradicating these 'Runners'.  But they would always return after each civilization was culled.
strings.zh: 是的，在泰肯消亡很久之后，终于出现了能移动的独立个体。此后各个世代会花上数千年清除这些「空降兵」。但每当一个文明被剔除，它们总会再度出现。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Scanners show a square structure in that extinct volcano.  The Digitalis growth area seems to center around that structure.
strings.zh: 扫描显示那座死火山里有一座方形结构。魔苋的生长区似乎以那座结构为中心。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: That's a Runner nest.  Once the Digitalis connects to the nest, Runners will emerge that walk around on the Digitalis like primitive animals.
strings.zh: 那是空降兵巢。一旦魔苋接入巢体，空降兵就会涌出，像原始动物一样在魔苋上行走。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: So the Digitalis not only copied plants but animals as well....  I see, how can we deal with them?
strings.zh: 所以魔苋不只复制了植物，还复制了动物……我明白了。我们该怎么对付它们？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Fortunately, the Runners are not overly aggressive and won't destroy your structures.  But, they have an energy stun weapon they use for self defense.  Any unit that gets in range of a Runner might be stunned.
strings.zh: 所幸空降兵并不算好斗，也不会摧毁你的建筑。但它们有一种用于自卫的能量眩晕武器。任何进入空降兵射程的单位都可能被眩晕。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: There is a Tech Artifact here...
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Not surprising to find this here.  The Sniper Tech is specifically designed to take out Runners at significant range.  Pick up this tech and use it to create a perimeter around your base and your units.  That should keep the Runners at bay.
strings.zh: 在这里找到它并不意外。狙击手科技正是为在远距离击倒空降兵而设计的。取得这项科技，用它在你基地和部队周围建立一圈防线。这样应该能把空降兵挡在外面。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The emitters on this world are very weak, but don't underestimate the Digitalis.  Use anything you have at your disposal to fight your way through.  Also, more tech level upgrades are available in the Forge.
strings.zh: 这个世界的发射器很弱，但别低估魔苋。用上你手里的一切手段，一路打过去。另外，锻造厂里还有更多科技等级升级可用。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Knuckle Cracker would like to thank all of the fans and supporters that made this game possible.
strings.zh: Knuckle Cracker谨向所有让这款游戏得以问世的粉丝与支持者致谢。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Without your patience and support, none of this would have been possible.  And frankly, I wouldn't have wanted to do it without you anyway.
strings.zh: 没有你们的耐心与支持，这一切都不可能实现。而且老实说，就算能做出来，我也不愿意在没有你们的陪伴下把它做完。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Thanks as always to Magnus aka MadMag (AcesHigh) for his awesome graphical talents and visual ideas.  Thanks as well to Grauniad for his patience and help with the Knuckle Cracker forums and for his ideas and support.
strings.zh: 一如既往地感谢Magnus（又名MadMag，AcesHigh），他出色的美术才华与视觉构想令人赞叹。同样感谢Grauniad，感谢他对Knuckle Cracker论坛的耐心付出，以及他的点子和支持。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: If you want to learn more about the composer of the awesome background music tracks, check out Finn M-K at composerprofiles.com/profile-finn-m-k and soundcloud.com/finnmk
strings.zh: 想更多了解那些出色背景音乐的作曲者，就去composerprofiles.com/profile-finn-m-k和soundcloud.com/finnmk看看Finn M-K。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: A special thanks in advance to all of the players of the game who create custom maps, make videos, tweet, facebook, google+, and all that stuff.  Your efforts make the community greater and stronger and are most appreciated.
strings.zh: 还要预先特别感谢所有自制地图、制作视频、发推、玩facebook、google+以及诸如此类的一切玩家。你们的付出让社区更大、更强，我十分感激。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Oh yeah... this mission!  Roam around my little dungeon and see what oddities you can find.  Use WASD or arrow keys to move, left mouse to fire (just hold it down).  Or you can click the right mouse button to turn on auto fire if your finger gets tired.
strings.zh: 对了……这个任务！在我这个小地牢里四处逛逛，看看你能撞见什么怪东西。用WASD或方向键移动，鼠标左键开火（按住不放就行）。手指按累了，也可以点右键打开自动开火。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Take out emitters by getting near (a red range will appear around the Emitter), then pressing SPACE to drop a Personal Nullification Device.  It takes 5 seconds to arm, but you probably knew that already.
strings.zh: 靠近发射器（它周围会显示一圈红色范围），然后按SPACE投下个人灭除装置，就能端掉它。装置需要5秒启动，这你大概早就知道了。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: And what about me?  Don't I get to say anything?
strings.zh: 那我呢？我就没得说两句？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Uh, yes...  Yes of course.  I was just saving the best for last!
strings.zh: 呃，有……当然有。我只是把最好的留到最后！
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en:
Uh hmmmm...
...
...
I forgot what I was going to say.
strings.zh:
呃……嗯……
……
……
我忘了自己要说什么了。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Excellent... this world should suffice for demonstrating the core capabilities of the ship.
strings.zh: 很好……这个世界足以用来演示这艘船的核心能力。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Yes, I'm afraid so.  Much has happened while you slept.  Dozens of human civilizations rose and fell, each trying ever more desperate measures as the Creeper would always return.
strings.zh: 是的，恐怕如此。你沉睡期间发生了很多事。数十个人类文明兴起又覆灭，每一个都尝试过越发绝望的手段，因为Creeper总会回来。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The last whispers of the final civilization haven't been heard in many thousands of years.  As far as my sensors can ascertain, only ruins remain.
strings.zh: 最后一个文明最后的低语，已经数千年无人听见。就我的传感器所能确认的，只剩下废墟。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: (Why was I forced to sleep through this all... only to awaken to utter desolation?)
strings.zh: （为什么我被迫睡过这一切……醒来却只见彻底的荒芜？）
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Strange... This world seems to contain some manner of pod.  Technological remnants are rare, so I would investigate.  Follow the ships automated assistance system, and acquire that pod...
strings.zh: 奇怪……这个世界似乎有某种舱体。技术遗存很罕见，我建议去查一查。跟随飞船的自动辅助系统，拿到那个舱体……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I've completed the scans of the various artifacts and technologies we have collected so far.
strings.zh: 我已完成了对我们迄今收集到的各类圣物与技术的扫描分析。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Did you find anything in common?  Perhaps something has been added to each item.
strings.zh: 有发现什么共同点吗？也许每件东西上都被添加了什么。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Nothing...  They are as diverse as any two random objects and contain nothing in common.
strings.zh: 什么都没有……它们就像任意两件东西一样各不相同，毫无共通之处。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Not so fast. We know that the Creeper did not destroy these artifacts but it did destroy other artifacts of the same kind. This can only mean one thing.
strings.zh: 别急。我们知道Creeper没有摧毁这些圣物，却摧毁了其他同类圣物。这只可能意味着一件事。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Ahh... The only thing these artifacts actually have in common is they were not destroyed by the Creeper.  That means...
strings.zh: 啊……这些圣物唯一的共同点，就是它们没有被Creeper摧毁。也就是说……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Yes, that means that the Creeper somehow recognized these specific artifacts and did not destroy them.  It didn't destroy them at any point in their existence, which spanned many millions of years in some cases.
strings.zh: 是的，也就是说Creeper以某种方式认出了这些特定的圣物，因而没有摧毁它们。在它们存在的任何时期都没有摧毁过——有些圣物跨越了数百万年。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: So the Creeper has a memory... a memory that spans vast amounts of space and time.  It also must rarely act in a selective way.   This never occurred to me before.  I've only ever imagined the Creeper as a random destructive force.
strings.zh: 所以Creeper拥有记忆……一种横跨广袤空间与时间的记忆。而且它必定极少做出选择性的行动。我以前从没想到过这一点。我一直只把Creeper当作一股随机的毁灭力量。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I'm not yet sure what good this knowledge will do us, Lia.  But it seems significant that the Creeper is more than just a blunt and crude weapon used by the Loki.
strings.zh: 我还不确定这个认识对我们有什么用处，莉娅。但Creeper不只是洛基使用的一件粗暴钝器，这似乎意义重大。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Have you completed your review of the Treatise on Cyclical Eternity yet?
strings.zh: 你对《循环永恒论》的研读完成了吗？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Not completely, but it looks like utter nonsense.  No other civilization posited such a concept as a "universal singleton", something of which only one could exist.  The name 'Arc Eternal', which the Seloi gave to this object, must have had nothing to do with their message to the Loki.
strings.zh: 还没有完全读完，但那东西看起来纯属胡言。没有别的文明提出过「宇宙单一体」这种概念——某种只能存在一个的东西。塞洛伊人给这个物体起的名字「永恒之弧」，一定与他们传给洛基的讯息无关。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I see...  So what do we have in this system?
strings.zh: 我明白了……那么这个星系里有什么？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: This system was last called "Frykt".  It now contains only three worlds, as the others have vanished.  Of the former worlds, one was deorbited into the sun, and three others were deconstructed into material for a failed Dyson sphere.
strings.zh: 这个星系最后的名称是「弗里克特」。现在它只剩下三个世界，其余的都消失了。在原有的世界中，一个被脱轨坠入恒星，另外三个被拆解，用作一座失败的戴森球的材料。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Only one world is not shielded, so we will head there first.
strings.zh: 只有一个世界没有护盾，我们先去那里。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: It would seem so...  Skars, if we manage to take out the Inhibitor on Vapen there will be a choice as to the next system in range.  I have no idea which path we should take...
strings.zh: 看来是这样……斯卡斯，如果我们能干掉瓦彭上的抑制器，接下来就有得选了，下一个射程内的星系是哪个。我完全不知道该走哪条路……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: We will cross that bridge when we get there Lia.  My daughter Aliana always accused me of leaping before looking, so I'll have no trouble choosing a destination.
strings.zh: 船到桥头自然直，莉娅。我女儿阿利安娜总说我做事不经大脑，所以选个目的地对我来说不成问题。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Something's wrong - we're coming down right in the pa...
strings.zh: 出问题了——我们正直接落进那……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: At last we have arrived at the Warp Inhibitor world in this system.
strings.zh: 我们终于抵达了这个星系里那颗带跃迁抑制器的星球。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: This world looks like it was engineered for a fight...
strings.zh: 这颗星球看着像是专门为打仗改造过的……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Indeed it was... There is Ticon military tech everywhere.  There are even three surviving Bertha Cannons.  It is surprising they have not been destroyed.
strings.zh: 确实如此……到处都是泰肯的军用技术。甚至还有三门幸存下来的贝莎炮。它们居然没被摧毁，真让人意外。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Bertha Cannons can fire massive projectiles anywhere on the map.  There is no better weapon for inflicting huge damage to the Creeper.  Their weakness is they require significant ammo and have a long fire cycle.
strings.zh: 贝莎炮能把巨型炮弹打到地图上任何位置。要给Creeper造成巨大伤害，没有比它更好的武器。缺点是弹药消耗很大，发射间隔也长。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: That sounds like something worth fighting for.  I'll make it a priority to secure them.
strings.zh: 听起来值得为它打一仗。我会优先拿下它们。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Lia, it seems that the Creeper ignores some things.  Artifacts, messages, tech, now these Bertha Cannons.  What do they have in common?
strings.zh: 莉娅，Creeper似乎会忽略一些东西。圣物、信息、技术，现在又是这些贝莎炮。它们有什么共同点？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Nothing intrinsic, perhaps there is something that has been added to each item.  I'll conduct careful scans of every item we have collected.  It will take some time to complete, however.
strings.zh: 本质上没有共同点。也许每件东西上都被加了什么。我会对我们收集到的每一件物品做仔细扫描。不过这需要一些时间。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Alright, I'll initiate ground actions and secure this world.  Looks like some Emitters and some Slip-Emitters.  Those Ticon Towers, perhaps they are inactive?
strings.zh: 好，我来发起地面行动，拿下这颗星球。看起来有些发射器，还有几个滑移发射器。那些泰肯塔，也许没有启动？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Parked over space... space that has been carefully carved into a pattern....  it seems unlikely, but perhaps...
strings.zh: 停在太空上方……一片被精心雕出图案的太空……不太可能，但也许……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Another Ticon weapon system corrupted by the Creeper?
strings.zh: 又一套被Creeper侵蚀的泰肯武器系统？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: It seems unlikely... but the Ticon developed Gliders that would move through space.  The idea was to hit the Creeper from where it was least likely to persist.
strings.zh: 不太可能……不过泰肯确实研制过能在太空中移动的滑翔机。思路是从Creeper最不可能驻留的地方打击它。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: These Gliders had powerful antimatter powered beams.  When in range they would combine all of their antimatter with matter and focus the energy into a beam.  Unfortunately for the Glider, it would be destroyed in the process.
strings.zh: 这些滑翔机装有强大的反物质光束。进入射程后，它们会把全部反物质与物质结合，将能量汇聚成一道光束。不幸的是，滑翔机自己也会在过程中被摧毁。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I have no records that the Ticon or any subsequent civilization ever got the system to work properly and reliably.  So, it is unlikely to find them here.  But this spatial pattern looks like one of the testing grounds.
strings.zh: 我的记录里，泰肯以及后来任何文明都没能让这套系统稳定可靠地运转。所以在这里遇到它们不太可能。但这片太空的图案，看上去像是当年的试验场之一。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: If this was a military testing ground and the Creeper has corrupted the Glider Tech, will there be any way to defend against it?
strings.zh: 如果这里是军事试验场，而Creeper又侵蚀了滑翔机技术，还有办法防住它吗？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Destruction of the Ticon Towers would prevent the creation of new Gliders.  Of course any unit that gets in range of a Glider will be destroyed.  The only weapon in our arsenal that might damage a Glider would be the Sniper.
strings.zh: 摧毁泰肯塔就能阻止新的滑翔机被造出来。当然，任何进入滑翔机射程的单位都会被摧毁。我们武器库里唯一可能伤到滑翔机的，只有狙击手。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The focused beam from the Sniper was designed to penetrate the Creeper infused shells of a Runner.  That might be enough to penetrate the shields around the Gliders.  But this is all theoretical... The Glider weapon system was never actually deployed.
strings.zh: 狙击手的聚焦光束，本来就是为穿透空降兵那层被Creeper浸透的外壳而设计的。那也许足以穿透滑翔机周围的护盾。但这都只是理论……滑翔机武器系统从未真正部署过。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Well Lia, I have a feeling we're about to find out otherwise...
strings.zh: 那么莉娅，我感觉我们马上就要验证出相反的答案了……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: It was a hard fight to collect this message, so tell me it isn't just some entertainment vid.
strings.zh: 为了拿到这条信息，我们打得够辛苦，所以告诉我，它不是什么娱乐影片吧。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I never would have believed we would find this... but this is the second part of the message we found on Ruine.
strings.zh: 我本来绝不会相信我们能找到这个……但这就是我们在鲁因发现的那条信息的第二部分。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The treatise on Cyclical Eternity from the Seloi?  I recall that the Seloi were the only civilization to contact the Loki and get a response.  They said something about an "Arc" and the Loki responded with, "More so than all others, YOU must perish".
strings.zh: 塞洛伊人那篇关于循环永恒的论著？我记得塞洛伊是唯一一个联系上洛基并得到回应的文明。他们提到了某个「弧」，洛基的回应是：「比其他所有文明更甚，你们必须灭亡」。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Yes, the Seloi were special in this regard and in many others....
strings.zh: 是的，在这方面，还有许多其他方面，塞洛伊都很特别……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: So the first part of the treatise on Cyclical Eternity proposed that it is possible to create a device... something unique and singular to each universe.
strings.zh: 那篇循环永恒论著的第一部分提出，有可能造出一种装置……每个宇宙中独一无二的、唯一的东西。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: But as I said on Ruine, the Seloi were prone to fanciful theories which had little connection to reality.
strings.zh: 但我在鲁因说过，塞洛伊人喜欢天马行空的理论，跟现实几乎没什么关系。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: If that is the case then why do you seem at all interested in the second part of the treatise?
strings.zh: 既然如此，那你为什么好像对论著的第二部分还有兴趣？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Because the name the Seloi gave to this theoretical device was; "Arc Eternal".
strings.zh: 因为塞洛伊人给这个理论装置起的名字是：「永恒之弧」。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I'll need more time to process all of the message... and hopefully understand it.  I suggest heading to the next system as soon as possible.
strings.zh: 我需要更多时间来处理这整条信息……希望也能弄懂它。我建议尽快前往下一个星系。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en:
This used to be an ancient human port.
It is no longer in use.
You can see many holes and problems  with the foundation that have formed.
strings.zh:
这里曾是古人类的一座港口。
如今已废弃不用。
你能看到地基上形成的许多破洞和问题。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: If it is no longer in use what are those ships doing there?
strings.zh: 既然已经不用了，那些船在那儿干什么？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: That's a strange formation around the emitter on this world.
strings.zh: 这颗星球的发射器周围有一圈奇怪的构造。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Yes, emitters arrived in ever more insidious ways.  Dropping from orbit, appearing directly out of Rift Space, subspace slips...
strings.zh: 是的，发射器的到来方式越来越隐蔽。从轨道上投放、直接从裂隙空间里出现、亚空间滑移……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: But why... Lia, in all the eons that have passed have you learned nothing about the Loki's true purpose?  Why do they cover all worlds in Creeper?
strings.zh: 可为什么……莉娅，过去了那么漫长的岁月，你对洛基真正的目的就一点都没查明吗？他们为什么要把所有世界都覆满Creeper？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Humans made three attempts to contact the Loki, only one was successful.  There was one age, one civilization that was different from all others that came before or after.   They called themselves simply the "Seloi".
strings.zh: 人类曾三次尝试联络洛基，只有一次成功。曾经有那么一个时代、一个文明，与它之前和之后的所有文明都不同。他们只自称「塞洛伊」。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The Seloi's greatness wasn't in their military might, their governance of a hundred thousand worlds, or the lasting peace they achieved.  Their greatness was in the 'serenity' of existence they achieved.
strings.zh: 塞洛伊的伟大不在于军力强盛，不在于统御十万个世界，也不在于他们缔造的持久和平。他们的伟大，在于他们达到的那种存在的「宁静」。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: They referred to this with a word not in your vocabulary, but what they achieved was an understanding and appreciation of the very fabric of existence.  In many ways they discovered the 'meaning' of existence.
strings.zh: 他们用一个不在你词汇表里的词来指称它，但他们所达到的，是对存在之纹理本身的理解与体认。在许多意义上，他们发现了存在的「意义」。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: And the Seloi were the ones to contact the Loki?
strings.zh: 而联络上洛基的就是塞洛伊人？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Yes.  When the end came for them as it did all others, they sent a message to the Loki pleading not for their lives but for something else.  Something they referred to simply as the "Arc".
strings.zh: 是的。当终局也如降临其他一切文明那样降临到他们头上时，他们向洛基发去讯息，所求的并非自己的性命，而是别的东西。一个他们只称作「弧」的东西。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: What was the "Arc" and what was the Loki's response?
strings.zh: 「弧」是什么？洛基的回应又是什么？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: What the Arc referenced is unknown.  Perhaps it was a late discovery of some technology by these humans, or perhaps it was a very closely guarded secret.  I have no other references to it.
strings.zh: 「弧」所指为何，无人知晓。也许是这些人类晚期发现的某种技术，也许是他们守护得极严的秘密。除此之外我再无相关记载。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: A single statement; "More so than all others, YOU must perish".
strings.zh: 只有一句话：「比之其他一切文明，你们更必须灭亡」。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Skars, this world contains two extinct volcanoes.  Emitters have taken up residence in each one .  I suggest you pick up the Strafer Tech Artifact on this world.
strings.zh: 斯卡斯，这颗星球上有两座死火山。发射器已经在两座火山里安了家。我建议你取走这颗星球上的俯冲机技术圣物。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I got it... The Strafers are aircraft and I can use them to suppress the volcanoes while I deal with the central emitter.
strings.zh: 明白了……俯冲机是飞行器，我可以用它们压制火山，同时去对付中央发射器。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Exactly.  You will likely need to target two Strafers on each volcano.  Don't waste any time... those volcanoes won't wait.
strings.zh: 正是。每座火山你大概都需要派两架俯冲机盯住。别浪费时间……那些火山不会等你。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Greetings commander, in this TEST we will be bringing back an aspect of your past....  No nullifires will be allowed in this map.  You will need to connect all totems to win.  Have fun!
strings.zh: 问候，指挥官。在这次测试中，我们要重现你过去的一环……本图不允许使用灭除器。你需要连接所有图腾才能获胜。玩得开心！
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: It seems quiet here... a kind of backwater system, removed from the comings and goings of most empires.  That makes it dangerous...
strings.zh: 这里似乎很安静……一个闭塞的星系，远离大多数帝国的往来。这反而危险……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Because I don't know much about it.  Little off-the-map places like this can often harbor great surprises.
strings.zh: 因为我对它了解不多。这种地图之外的小地方，往往藏着大惊喜。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Yes, and it is a world that was left undisturbed for most of its existence.  It appears to contain an Inhibitor, though.  Someone must have recently placed it there.
strings.zh: 是的，而且这个世界在其存在的大部分时间里都不受打扰。不过它上面似乎有一个抑制器。一定是最近有人把它放在那里的。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: What lies beyond this system once we take out the Inhibitor?
strings.zh: 我们干掉抑制器之后，这个星系之外是什么？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Scanning... It looks like a stable wormhole, Skars!  Fascinating.  For all the unassumingness of this system, it is actually a gateway to another region of space.  One about which I know nothing.  That wormhole could lead to anywhere in the universe...
strings.zh: 正在扫描……看起来是一个稳定的虫洞，斯卡斯！太奇妙了。这个星系看似毫不起眼，实际上却是通往另一片星域的大门。一片我一无所知的星域。那个虫洞可能通往宇宙中的任何地方……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: This world also contains a Shield Key.  Odd since this system contains no shielded worlds.
strings.zh: 这个世界还有一把护盾钥匙。奇怪的是，这个星系里并没有带护盾的世界。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I'll engage and collect the key and take out the Inhibitor.  As interesting as another region of space sounds, I have a feeling it isn't part of our current journey.  But perhaps we can come back and explore it later...
strings.zh: 我会接战，取回钥匙并干掉抑制器。另一片星域听起来确实有趣，但我感觉它不在我们这次的旅程里。不过也许以后我们能回来探索它……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: They won't work here, so I temporary removed them from your control panel. Scanners say that the creeper also reacts different here. Experiment to find a way to push back the creeper.
strings.zh: 它们在这里不管用，所以我暂时从你的控制面板上撤掉了。扫描显示，Creeper在这里的反应也不一样。自己试试，找出把Creeper推回去的办法。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Once all totems are powered you can start nullifying and I'll enable the nullifiers again.
strings.zh: 所有图腾供能之后，你就能开始灭除，我也会重新开放灭除器。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en:
Activate all spatial totems to destroy the enemy!
Click each totem or use the number keys to toggle each peg. Moving some pegs unlocks others.  Press "space" to reset the puzzle and zero the game time.
strings.zh:
激活所有空间图腾，摧毁敌人！
点击每个图腾，或用数字键切换每个销钉。移动某些销钉会解锁其他销钉。按「space」键可重置谜题，并将游戏时间归零。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I have only one thing I can say about this: This is going to be very difficult.
strings.zh: 对此我只有一句话可说：这会非常艰难。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The first spore will come in one minute. Digitalis will slowly enter your base. You might want to enable show digi growth area to see the progress.
strings.zh: 第一枚孢子一分钟后到达。魔苋会慢慢侵入你的基地。你也许可以打开「显示魔苋生长区」，看看进度。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Any unit near the core will slowly die and lose all ammo, in return, their max health will increase.
strings.zh: 任何靠近核心的单位都会慢慢死亡、耗尽弹药，作为交换，它们的生命上限会提升。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: If you manage to kill the tower, 4 copies of the tower will spawn in the corners. So be prepared for a lot of spores. I'll remind you by that time.
strings.zh: 如果你成功打掉那座塔，四个角落会各生成一座它的复制体。所以做好迎接大量孢子的准备。到那时我会提醒你。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: For now, build out as fast as possible and get a beam online.
strings.zh: 眼下，尽快扩张，把光束先架起来。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I present to you: Warzone! This is the first map I made in one of the earliest builds of the game (way back in alpha!). Here it is, in its most raw form, aside from some added totems, this is the orginal map, just pure Creeper World Chaos! Also check out "War Zone" which is the updated version of this map for maximum madness!
strings.zh: 我向你们呈上：Warzone！这是我用游戏极早期版本做的第一张地图（远在alpha时代！）。就是它，最原始的形态——除了加了几座图腾，这就是原版地图，纯粹的Creeper World混沌！另外也去看看「War Zone」，那是这张地图的更新版，疯狂程度拉满！
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: There must be something wrong here. That emitter is showing extreme activity.
strings.zh: 这里一定有问题。那个发射器活动异常剧烈。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: It recieves energy from unactivated totems. Try to connect (and arm!) all totems before attacking that emitter.
strings.zh: 它从尚未激活的图腾那里获取能量。试着在进攻那个发射器之前，把所有图腾连接（并装填！）好。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: This used to be 'Flick', a world that supported a population of over 10 billion.  It was torn apart by a collision... a big one.  Something that the planetary shield couldn't stop.
strings.zh: 这里曾是「弗里克」，一个养活了超过100亿人口的世界。它被一次碰撞撕碎了……一次巨大的碰撞。那是行星护盾也无法阻挡的东西。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Like all the worlds in this system, this world wasn't even born when you were last awake.  This entire system developed, lived, and died while you slept.
strings.zh: 和这个星系里所有的世界一样，你上次清醒时，这个世界甚至还未诞生。整个星系在你沉睡期间诞生、繁盛，又死去。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: There appears to only be one emitter left on one of the larger asteroids, along with an intact Shield Key and a new Tech Artifact.
strings.zh: 看起来只剩一颗较大的小行星上还有一座发射器，此外还有一把完好的护盾钥匙和一件新的技术圣物。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Look more carefully, Skars.  This emitter has deployed Subspace-Slip Emitters.  These aren't true emitters, but are channels in subspace that the Master Emitter uses to dispense Creeper.
strings.zh: 看仔细些，斯卡斯。这座发射器部署了亚空间滑移发射器。它们不是真正的发射器，而是主发射器用来输送Creeper的亚空间通道。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: This allows the emitter to deposit Creeper in different locations all at once.  The civilization that first encountered this adaptation were crushed in less than one standard earth year.
strings.zh: 这让发射器能同时在多个不同地点投放Creeper。最先遭遇这种变异的文明，在不到一个标准地球年的时间里就被碾碎了。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Can these Slip-Emitters be destroyed with Nullifiers?
strings.zh: 这些滑移发射器能用灭除器摧毁吗？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: In a word, "No".  There is nothing to destroy.  They are just rips in subspace that the Master Emitter uses to transport Creeper.  The only way to seal them is to destroy the Master Emitter.
strings.zh: 一句话，「不」。没有什么可摧毁的。它们只是主发射器用来运送Creeper的亚空间裂口。要封闭它们，唯一的办法就是摧毁主发射器。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The best you can do is to establish a foothold on surrounding asteroids, then deploy weapons and AntiCreeper to hold the Slip-Emitters at bay.
strings.zh: 你能做的最好的事，就是在周边的小行星上建立立足点，然后部署武器和Anti-Creeper，把滑移发射器压制住。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The Bomber Tech Artifact should prove useful.  These air/space craft can deliver AC remotely.
strings.zh: 轰炸机技术圣物应该会很有用。这种空天飞行器可以远程投放AC。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Yes... I'll saturate these asteroids with AC.  Then, we'll get out of here.  There is nothing left here but death and destruction.
strings.zh: 是的……我会用AC把这群小行星彻底浸透。然后，我们就离开这里。这里除了死亡与毁灭，什么都不剩了。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: We've arrived in the Andere system, as it was last called.  Sensors are off the charts, and need recalibrating...
strings.zh: 我们已抵达安德雷星系——它最后的名称。传感器读数爆表，需要重新校准……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: What's the source of the interference?
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: It isn't interference, it's information.  There are billions of data streams across billions of channels all carrying vast amounts of data... it's too... it's too much...
strings.zh: 不是干扰，是信息。数十亿条数据流横跨数十亿个频道，全都承载着海量数据……太多了……太多了……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Shut down the sensors Lia!  Do it now!
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: ... ... The data streams...  I have the sensors shut down now.  The amount of information being transmitted was incalculable, Skars.  It was blinding to my Gel circuits.  I've never encountered anything as complex and ordered and on such a scale.
strings.zh: …… ……数据流……我已经把传感器关掉了。传输的信息量无法估量，斯卡斯。它让我的凝胶回路都晃得看不见东西。我从未遇到过如此复杂、如此有序、规模如此之大的东西。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Could you determine anything about the signals?  Their source, their content, their purpose?
strings.zh: 你能判断出那些信号的信息吗？来源、内容、目的？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The signals appear to be coming from everywhere, but focused on this system.  It is like someone encoded quadrillions of yottabytes of data into the background radiation of the universe.  It is near the quantum limit for information density.
strings.zh: 信号似乎来自四面八方，却集中在这个星系。就像有人把数千万亿尧字节的数据编码进了宇宙的背景辐射里。这已接近信息密度的量子极限。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: What is in the message?  Did you ascertain anything?
strings.zh: 讯息里是什么？你查明了什么吗？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: It seems to be everything, Skars?  Just 'everything'.
strings.zh: 似乎就是一切，斯卡斯？就只是「一切」。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I don't understand, everything of what?
strings.zh: 我不明白，一切中的什么？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Everything that has ever been.  It's exact state information... it's... think of it like a very precise plan for how to make everything that has ever existed.
strings.zh: 曾经存在过的一切。是精确的状态信息……是……把它想成一份极其精密的图纸，能造出曾经存在过的一切。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Every leaf on every tree that has ever existed on every world, every grain of sand, every star, every molecule of every atmosphere that has bent the light of its star into a sunset...
strings.zh: 每一棵树上每一片曾经存在过的叶子，每一粒沙，每一颗星，每一层大气中的每一个分子——那些大气曾把恒星的光弯成一场日落……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Do this, enable visual spectrum sensors only for this System.  Let's look at the system with just our eyes...
strings.zh: 这样，只为这个星系开启可见光谱传感器。我们只用眼睛看看这个星系……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: OK, looks like two worlds, one shielded and one not.  My records indicate these worlds were last called Otrav and Farbor.  There was nothing particularly remarkable about either world over the last few billion years.
strings.zh: 好，看起来是两个世界，一个有护盾，一个没有。我的记录显示这两个世界最后的名称是奥特拉夫和法博。过去几十亿年里，这两个世界都没有什么特别之处。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: You said the sensor streams seemed focused on this system... any particular region in this system?
strings.zh: 你说传感器数据流似乎集中在这个星系……是这个星系里的某个特定区域吗？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Yes, good question.  In the time I sampled the streams they appear to be.... That's interesting.
strings.zh: 是的，问得好。在我采样数据流的那段时间里，它们似乎……有意思。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The focus appears to be changing slightly so that the signals are at their peak over Farbor.  The signal focus is somehow tracking the orbit of that world.
strings.zh: 焦点似乎略有变化，使信号在法博上空达到最强。信号焦点在某种程度上正跟随着那个世界的轨道。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Then that's where we are headed Lia...  The Loki must be behind these signals and this world must be significant somehow.
strings.zh: 那我们就去那里，莉娅……这些信号背后一定是洛基，而那个世界必定有某种重要意义。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I'll attempt to install some filters on the sensors so I can better sample the streams. That should allow us to perhaps learn some more about the intent of the signals.
strings.zh: 我会试着给传感器装上一些滤波器，好更清楚地采样数据流。那样我们也许能多了解一些这些信号的意图。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I'll head to Otrav and pick up any shield keys there...
strings.zh: 我先去奥特拉夫，把那里的护盾钥匙都收走……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.zh: 那些看起来像是原始遗迹？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Yes, they were meant to look that way.  This was a camouflage world.  Some civilizations attempted to hide from the Creeper by removing all obvious traces of higher technology.
strings.zh: 是的，它们本来就是故意做成那样。这是一颗伪装星球。有些文明试图抹去一切高等技术的痕迹，以此躲避Creeper。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: It obviously didn't work.... the Creeper must have either not cared, or seen through the charade.
strings.zh: 显然没用……Creeper要么根本不在意，要么看穿了这场伪装。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Some cultures on some worlds went so far as to actually maintain a more primitive existence.  They lost all advanced knowledge and even contact with the rest of humanity.  This appears to be one of those worlds.
strings.zh: 有些星球上的文明甚至真的维持着更原始的生活。他们失去了所有先进知识，甚至与其余人类的联系。这颗星球似乎是其中之一。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Those step pyramids, there are strange readings coming from them.
strings.zh: 那些阶梯金字塔，从里面传出奇怪的读数。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The last indigenous culture must have taken technological artifacts and built these pyramids around them.  Perhaps they worshipped them or revered them in some way.  Impossible to know for sure...
strings.zh: 最后的本土文明一定是把技术圣物取来，围着它们建起了这些金字塔。也许他们崇拜过、敬畏过这些圣物。已经无法确知了……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: But what I can say for sure is that the artifacts in those pyramids still appear functional, and they are rather advanced.  Skars, connect the peak of each pyramid to your power grid...
strings.zh: 但我能确定的是，那些金字塔里的圣物似乎仍能运作，而且相当先进。斯卡斯，把每座金字塔的顶端接入你的电网……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Each pyramid contains a defensive device that you should be able to power.  I'm not sure exactly what each will do, but it looks like someone long ago placed these artifacts here.  Perhaps it was hoped they would defend the population.
strings.zh: 每座金字塔里都有一件防御装置，你应该能为它供能。我不确定每一件具体会做什么，但看起来是很久以前有人把这些圣物放在这里。也许他们期望这些圣物能保护民众。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Interesting... and perhaps they did protect the population for some time.  Perhaps some inhabitants even managed to escape, for a while anyway.  In any case, I'll power the pyramids and take out that Inhibitor.
strings.zh: 有意思……也许它们确实保护了民众一段时间。也许有些居民还设法逃了出去，至少暂时如此。不管怎样，我会给金字塔供能，然后干掉那个抑制器。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: You should really turn off ammo packets at the start, at least until you've built a few reactors.
strings.zh: 开局你最好把弹药包关掉，至少等到建好几座反应堆再说。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Hey guys! This was the map created for a Demo of How to create a map! I hope you enjoy it!
strings.zh: 大家好！这张地图是为「如何制作地图」的演示而做的！希望你们喜欢！
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Excellent... That pod from planet Tempus contained a shield key for this planet.  Obtaining it allowed us to lower the shield and access this planet.
strings.zh: 太好了……从坦普斯星来的那个舱里，装着这颗星球的护盾钥匙。拿到它，我们才得以降下护盾，进入这颗星球。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Entire planets shielded?  This must have been some desperate attempt to defend against the Creeper.
strings.zh: 整颗整颗的星球都加了护盾？这一定是当年为了抵御Creeper的绝望之举。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: One that sadly failed.  The human civilization that developed this shielding technology had high hopes.  They accomplished many great and magnificent feats.  But the end came for them just like all the others...
strings.zh: 可惜失败了。发展出这项护盾技术的人类文明曾满怀希望。他们完成过许多伟大而壮丽的壮举。可结局还是和所有其他文明一样……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: There is a large structure here.  This must be the Warp Inhibitor?
strings.zh: 这里有个巨大的结构。这应该就是跃迁抑制器？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Yes, these inhibitors restrict warp travel to other systems.  We need to destroy this inhibitor so we can leave this system.  Destroying the Inhibitor will destroy all other enemies on the map.
strings.zh: 是的，这些抑制器会限制通往其他星系的跃迁。我们得摧毁它，才能离开这个星系。摧毁抑制器会连带消灭地图上所有其他敌人。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Why would the Creeper, or Loki, build Warp Inhibitors?
strings.zh: Creeper，或者说洛基，为什么要建跃迁抑制器？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: They did not.  I recommend acting quickly and getting us out of here Skars.  No world is ever safe for long...
strings.zh: 他们没建。斯卡斯，我建议速战速决，带我们离开这里。没有哪个世界能长久安全……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en:
Skars... wake up.
SKARS!....

COMMANDER SKARSGARD ABRAXIS!
strings.zh:
斯卡斯……醒醒。
斯卡斯！……

指挥官斯卡斯加德·阿布拉克斯！
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Uh.. where... wha?  Wait a minute, who are you?
strings.zh: 呃……这是哪儿……什么？等一下，你是谁？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I'll keep the ship lights very low.  You have slept for a very long time.  My name is Lia.
strings.zh: 我会把船上的灯光调得很暗。你已经睡了很久很久。我叫莉娅。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I don't know any 'Lia'.  The last thing I remember is Platius laughing and saying, 'Fortuna favet fatuis'.  Where am I, where is Platius, and who are you?
strings.zh: 我不认识什么「莉娅」。我记得的最后一幕，是普拉提乌斯大笑着说了一句「Fortuna favet fatuis」。我在哪儿？普拉提乌斯在哪儿？你又是谁？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Slowly...  Platius created me shortly after he placed you in suspended animation.  I was your guardian for the eons that passed.  I have watched over and protected you for many cycles...
strings.zh: 别急……普拉提乌斯把你送入休眠之后不久，就创造了我。在逝去的无数纪元里，我是你的守护者。多少个周期以来，我一直看护着你、护着你……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I am part of this ship we are on.  We have been in orbit around a stable singularity for many eons.... hiding from all that transpired.
strings.zh: 我就是我们所在的这艘船的一部分。许多纪元以来，我们一直环绕着一处稳定的奇点运行……躲避着外界发生的一切。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: It is difficult to measure because of the expansion of space, the rift space cataclysm, variations in various cosmological constants....
strings.zh: 很难计量，因为空间在膨胀，有裂隙空间的灾变，还有各种宇宙常数的变动……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Quit stalling, just a round figure....
strings.zh: 别绕弯子，给个大概数字……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.zh: 超过五十亿地球标准年。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en:
My Gods....
...
WHY?  ANSWER ME, WHY???
strings.zh:
我的神啊……
……
为什么？回答我，为什么？！
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I'm sorry Skars....  All I know is that 'now' is when I was to awaken you.  I, and this ship, are now at your disposal.  My only instructions from this point forward are to follow your commands.
strings.zh: 对不起，斯卡斯……我只知道，「现在」就是我该唤醒你的时刻。从今往后，我和这艘船都听你调遣。我接到的唯一指令，就是服从你的命令。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: None of this makes any sense, or even seems possible.  But, I long ago abandoned the concept of 'impossible', so let's take a look.  Ship's sensors indicate we are no longer orbiting a singularity...
strings.zh: 这一切都说不通，甚至不像可能发生的事。但我早就抛弃了「不可能」这个概念，那就看看吧。船的传感器显示，我们已不再环绕奇点……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Correct, I warped the ship to a nearby star system to begin the reactivation process.  Unfortunately, there appears to be a warp inhibitor in this system so we are stuck here till you do something about it.
strings.zh: 没错，我把船跃迁到了邻近的星系，以启动重启程序。可惜这个星系里似乎有跃迁抑制器，所以在你想出办法之前，我们只能困在这里。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Move the ship to 'Tempus'... the world without a shield. Then launch ground activities.  I'll explain more once there...
strings.zh: 把船移到「坦普斯」……那颗没有护盾的星球。然后发起地面行动。到了那里我再详细解释……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The phrase "beau geste" is from the French, meaning "a gracious (or fine) gesture".
strings.zh: 「beau geste」这个短语来自法语，意思是「优雅的（或漂亮的）姿态」。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: In French, the phrase includes the suggestion of a fine gesture with unwelcome or futile consequences.
strings.zh: 在法语里，这个短语还暗含一层意思：一次漂亮的姿态，带来的却是不受欢迎或徒劳的后果。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: In English, "geste" is a homophone with "jest," meaning "a joke" or "to joke." As a pun, a "beau geste" may therefore indicate a beautiful (or poignant) joke.
strings.zh: 在英语里，「geste」与「jest」同音，而「jest」意为「玩笑」或「开玩笑」。所以作为一个双关，「beau geste」也可以指一个美丽（或辛酸）的玩笑。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: It's also a movie with a desert fortress under attack...
strings.zh: 这也是一部电影的名字，讲的是沙漠堡垒遭到围攻……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en:
Thanks to Virgil for the scripts and images (that i shamelessly "borrowed" from the meso map).
The idols have quite high energy demand, make sure you can run them before you hook them up!
strings.zh:
感谢Virgil提供脚本与图像（我从梅索那张地图上毫不脸红地「借」来的）。
这些神像的能耗相当高，接上去之前先确认你供得起！
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Barren... this world has seen better days.
strings.zh: 荒芜……这个世界也曾有过好日子。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Yes, a very long time ago Jojo was a world with great mountains and vast oceans.  Humans across the vastness of time would visit this world for the beauty it offered.
strings.zh: 是的，很久很久以前，乔乔曾是一个有着巍峨山脉与辽阔海洋的世界。在漫长的时间长河里，人类会为了它的美景造访这里。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: And now it's a gray rock in space, with wait... What are those strange Towers?
strings.zh: 而现在它只是太空中一块灰色的石头，等等……那些奇怪的塔是什么？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: In the south there are three Spore Towers, along with three emitters.  Fortunately, there is a Beam Tech Artifact on the central island.
strings.zh: 南方有三座孢子塔，还有三座发射器。幸运的是，中央岛屿上有一件光束技术圣物。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Aerial Spores....  Coincidence?  On the first world we encounter with Spores there is also a technology to defend against the Spores?
strings.zh: 空中孢子……巧合吗？我们遇到的第一个有孢子的世界，恰好也有能抵御孢子的技术？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: This is all so similar to the original exodus of Odin City.  I always believed Platius had placed the artifacts we found on our journey...
strings.zh: 这一切和当初奥丁城的出走太像了。我一直相信，我们旅途上找到的圣物都是普拉提乌斯放置的……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I have no record of Platius since I was constructed.  If he was present over the eons, he was very well hidden.
strings.zh: 自我被建造以来，没有任何关于普拉提乌斯的记录。如果他在这千万年间存在，那他藏得非常深。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I see.  I'll collect that Beam Tech Artifact and construct several Beam units to defend our base.  That should protect the units while I take out the emitters and towers.
strings.zh: 我明白了。我会去取那件光束技术圣物，造几台光束单位来守住基地。那样在我拔掉发射器和孢子塔时，部队就能得到保护。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Welcome to the Creeper Simulation Machine Version 6.1, My name is CS Advanced.  Welcome to your training as a Challenger of the Creeper.
strings.zh: 欢迎使用Creeper模拟机6.1版，我是CS Advanced。欢迎参加「Creeper挑战者」训练。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Hello Trainee! I am CAIN, Comand Node Artifical Intelligence. I trust that you can get yourself through the mission, so I wil be mostly silent and just take notes on your performance.
strings.zh: 你好，受训者！我是CAIN，指挥节点人工智能。我相信你能自己完成任务，所以我会大多保持沉默，只记录你的表现。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Mission Report: Many emitters are in this world but you get some high ground to start. Runners and an air tower block your path. Collect the tech artifacts for more assistance on your battle.
strings.zh: 任务报告：这个世界有许多发射器，但开局你拥有一片高地。空降兵和一座空中塔挡住去路。收集技术圣物，为你的战斗取得更多助力。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Prepare the simulation, I am engaing the creeper in battle!
strings.zh: 准备模拟，我要与Creeper开战了！
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Simulation Number 84497884 starting please stand by to engage.
strings.zh: 模拟编号84497884即将开始，请待命投入交战。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I have almost completed the simulation. May I recieve my next instructions?
strings.zh: 模拟我已基本完成。可以接收下一条指令了吗？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: You did very well on this mission. The next one won't be so easy however, prepare yourself for a challenging battle.
strings.zh: 这次任务你做得非常好。不过下一场不会这么轻松，做好准备迎接挑战吧。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Simulation Number 84497884 is almost complete preparing to stop simulation machine.
strings.zh: 模拟编号84497884即将完成，准备停止模拟机。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: What is this? A new enemy?
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: No. My records say that in this place humanity tried to kill a single emitter. They used their own cores to create anti-creeper and AC spores, slowly growing stronger and stronger.
strings.zh: 不是。我的记录说，人类曾在这里试图消灭一个单独的发射器。他们用自己的核心制造Anti-Creeper和AC孢子，慢慢变得越来越强。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Many years later the creeper returned and it took over their systems.
strings.zh: 许多年后，Creeper回来了，接管了他们的系统。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: So I now have to fight something that the humanity made to kill the creeper? Then you might know what it does.
strings.zh: 所以我现在要打的，是人类为了消灭Creeper而造出来的东西？那你大概知道它的作用。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Our nullifiers are not strong enough to destroy it. The core creates a lot of child cores using the energy stored. Those cores will gather some energy on their runs and will return all energy back to the main core after completing their run.
strings.zh: 我们的灭除器不够强，毁不掉它。核心会用储存的能量制造大量子核心。这些核心会在行动途中收集一些能量，跑完一圈后把所有能量送回主核心。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Nullify cores to 'drain' some energy of the main core. Once it's energy falls below a point it will sacrifice its immunity against our nullifiers for a small burst of destruction and some extra energy.
strings.zh: 灭除子核心，就能「抽走」主核心的一部分能量。等它的能量掉到某个值以下，它会短暂放弃对灭除器的免疫，换取一次小规模的毁灭爆发和一点额外能量。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Be prepared for a lot of spores and build a few mortars to keep the creeper density's low.
strings.zh: 做好应对大量孢子的准备，造几门迫击炮，把Creeper的密度压下去。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Is there a way to win this fight, or are you doomed to failure?
strings.zh: 这场仗有赢的办法吗，还是说注定要失败？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: This doesn't look good.  There is some Ticon tech here, but the structure isn't something they built.  This is very unusual.
strings.zh: 情况不妙。这里有泰肯科技，但这座结构不是他们建造的。这非常反常。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Lia, there seems to be a pattern in the worlds we are visiting.  We know that the Creeper all but destroys everything in its path.  Something to do with entropy, or so my daughter Aliana once told me.  But each world we visit has something of value.
strings.zh: 莉娅，我们造访的这些世界似乎存在某种规律。我们知道Creeper几乎会摧毁途经的一切。这跟熵有关，我女儿阿利安娜曾这么跟我说过。可我们造访的每个世界，都留着有价值的东西。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.zh: 莉娅？有什么值得担心的吗？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Yes.... we have a serious problem on this world.  The emitter here is using subspace-slips.  But, the exit points aren't stable.  I have not encountered this before.
strings.zh: 是的……这个世界有严重问题。这里的发射器在使用亚空间滑移。但出口点并不稳定。我以前从未遇到过。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Not encountered it before?  Billions of years of observation and something you have not seen?  This can only mean one thing.  Something is aware of our presence and adapting.
strings.zh: 从未遇到过？数十亿年的观测，竟有你没见过的东西？这只能说明一件事。有某个存在察觉到了我们，而且在适应。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: This is possible, we have been very visible for some time now.  If this is the case, then we will be hunted ever more aggressively on each world.  This will complicate our exploration...
strings.zh: 有可能，我们近来确实相当显眼。若真是如此，我们在每个世界都会遭到越来越猛烈的猎杀。这会让我们的探索变得更复杂……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Focus on the task at hand... there is a Tech Artifact here.  It looks like some Ticon tech.
strings.zh: 先专注眼前的任务……这里有一件技术圣物。看起来是某种泰肯科技。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Yes, seems to be shield tech.  This may be the only way to survive this world, Skars.  Shields will repulse Creeper, but require significant amounts of energy.
strings.zh: 是的，似乎是护盾科技。这也许是撑过这个世界的唯一办法，斯卡斯。护盾能击退Creeper，但需要大量能量。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I have also managed to enable some more upgrades in the Ticon Forge we acquired at Lemal.  I recommend constructing a Forge, and upgrading infrastructure as the situation demands.
strings.zh: 我还设法启用了我们在莱马尔缴获的泰肯锻造厂里的几项新升级。我建议建造一座锻造厂，并视情况升级基础设施。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I'll land a Command Node in the center of the base and focus on defense and energy... lots of it.  Let's hope those shields are useful against these random slip emitters.
strings.zh: 我会把指挥节点降落在基地中央，重点放在防御和能量上……要很多能量。但愿那些护盾对这群随机滑移的发射器管用。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Protect these dunes against the creeper Skars. In 2 minutes a gaint wave of creeper will appear, so get your bertha's ready!
strings.zh: 斯卡斯，守住这些沙丘，挡住Creeper。两分钟后会涌来一大波Creeper，把你的贝莎炮准备好！
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: This world is covered with tech and none of it looks very friendly.
strings.zh: 这颗星球上布满了科技造物，可没有一样看着友善。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: It is tech, that is for sure.  It doesn't appear to be directed toward any offensive or defensive purpose, though.
strings.zh: 确实是科技造物，这点毫无疑问。不过它似乎并不指向任何进攻或防御用途。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: That is odd, since most civilizations were interested in defending themselves and the Creeper was interested in destroying them.
strings.zh: 那就怪了，大多数文明都热衷于自我防卫，而Creeper热衷于毁灭它们。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: This world has been designed to concentrate Creeper on each hill top in sequence.  That old Ticon facility in the east is projecting dual attraction fields that rove over the terrain.
strings.zh: 这颗星球被设计成让Creeper依次聚集到每一座山顶上。东边那座废弃的泰肯设施正投射出两重引力场，在地表上来回游走。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: What purpose is there in concentrating Creeper like that?  It makes it harder to destroy, but this world doesn't appear configured for defense.
strings.zh: 把Creeper这样聚集起来有什么目的？这让它更难被消灭，但这颗星球看起来并没有为防御做过配置。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Could it have anything to do with the intense signals you have detected focused on this system?  Focus your scanners on a hill top...
strings.zh: 这会不会和你探测到的、集中在这个星系的强烈信号有关？把扫描器对准一座山顶……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: This is interesting, and subtle.  It seems that the structure on each hill is designed as a transmitter.  When the Creeper pools over each transmitter, I assume that is when each will transmit.
strings.zh: 有意思，而且很隐蔽。每座山顶上的结构似乎都设计成了发射器。当Creeper汇聚到每个发射器上时，我推测那就是它们各自发射的时刻。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: And this is where the signal in this system is coming from?
strings.zh: 那么这个星系的信号就是从这儿来的？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Absolutely not.  Well, some tiny fraction of it perhaps.  The signals in this system must be coming from billions of other worlds just like this one... all transmitting at the same time.
strings.zh: 绝对不是。嗯，也许其中有极小的一部分。这个星系里的信号必定来自数十亿颗和这一颗一样的星球……全都在同一时刻发射。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: It's the Loki... it must be.  Everything over the last 10 billion years, their campaign to destroy everything in the universe with the Creeper... it has all been building to this.
strings.zh: 是洛基……一定是他们。过去一百亿年里的一切，他们用Creeper毁灭宇宙万物的战争……全都在为这一刻铺路。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Skars, if all of the Creeper from across the universe is the source of the signals it means the Creeper doesn't just destroy things.  It also remembers things in exacting detail. It would only be bound by the uncertainty principle, unless...
strings.zh: 斯卡斯，如果全宇宙的Creeper就是这些信号的源头，那就意味着Creeper不只毁灭万物，它还以极其精确的细节记住万物。它唯一受制的只有不确定性原理，除非……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: We are going to destroy those transmitters, that field projector, and collect the shield key from this world.  We must reach the next world in this system and discover what the Loki are doing.
strings.zh: 我们要摧毁那些发射器、那座场投射器，并从这颗星球上取走护盾钥匙。我们必须抵达这个星系里的下一颗星球，查明洛基在做什么。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: This is the Navox system.  The worlds here have varied histories.
strings.zh: 这里是纳沃克斯星系。这里的各个星球有着各不相同的历史。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: It seems that Flick and Tiplex are both shielded but the other three worlds are not.
strings.zh: 看来「弗里克」和「蒂普莱克斯」都有护盾，另外三颗没有。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Correct.  You have a choice as to how to proceed.  Scanners show various artifacts scattered across the worlds.  So the order you visit the worlds will determine what technologies we acquire first.
strings.zh: 没错。要怎么走由你选。扫描显示，各星球上散落着各种圣物。所以你访问星球的顺序，会决定我们先获得哪些技术。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Tiplex is where the Inhibitor is, but it appears to require multiple shield keys.  That world must have been more important than others...
strings.zh: 抑制器在蒂普莱克斯，但那里似乎需要多把护盾钥匙。那颗星球想必比别的更重要……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Choose one of the three worlds and engage ground operations.  I'll explain what I know of each world in turn...
strings.zh: 从这三颗星球里挑一个，开始地面作战吧。关于每颗星球，我会把我知道的依次讲给你听……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: go north or go east, it's up to you, but connecting point to point will give you what you need to win. (scripts from meso, thanks again Virgil, i love these powered idols!)
strings.zh: 往北还是往东，随你，但把点与点连起来，才会给你取胜所需的东西。（脚本来自梅索，再次感谢Virgil，我爱死这些带能量的神像了！）
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: tek tip! packet speed is probably a good idea!
strings.zh: teks小提示！把能量包速度升上去，大概是个好主意！
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I'm not even going to ask... just let me have it.
strings.zh: 我都不打算问了……直接说吧。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: There is a corrupted Ticon space weapon here.  It was another experimental system that I thought the Ticon never actually deployed but obviously did.
strings.zh: 这里有一件被侵蚀的泰肯太空武器。那是另一套实验性系统，我以为泰肯从未实际部署过，但显然他们部署了。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: We've faced their tech before, this can't be any worse.
strings.zh: 我们以前也面对过他们的技术，这不会更糟。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: You may be right.  The station appears to be malfunctioning and operating in a much diminished capacity.  Its targeting sensors are destroyed as well.  So whatever it fires, it will be firing randomly into space.
strings.zh: 也许你说得对。这座空间站似乎出了故障，运转能力大幅下降。它的瞄准传感器也被摧毁了。所以不管它发射什么，都只会朝太空里乱打。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Is that Ticon space station also acting as a Warp Inhibitor?
strings.zh: 那座泰肯空间站也在充当跃迁抑制器吗？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Yes... oddly so.  That is very strange since Warp Inhibitors were developed after the Ticon empire. Someone must have added the inhibitor to the station after it was built and corrupted.
strings.zh: 是的……说来也怪。这非常反常，因为跃迁抑制器是在泰肯帝国之后才被研发出来的。一定有人在空间站建成并被侵蚀之后，给它加装了抑制器。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Perhaps someone wanted to protect access to the wormhole beyond this system?  No matter... we're taking it out.  Any assault advice?
strings.zh: 也许有人想守住通往这个星系之外那座虫洞的通道？无所谓……我们要把它拆掉。有什么进攻建议吗？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: None... it isn't clear how you will assault that heavily defended world fragment or reach the station.
strings.zh: 没有……我看不出你要如何进攻那块防御森严的世界残片，或者如何抵达那座空间站。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: This world is barely being held together.  It's near the end for this world.... geological forces have torn it apart, and disturbances in this system have done the rest.
strings.zh: 这个世界几乎要散架了。它已临近终结……地质力量已将它撕裂，而这片星系的扰动完成了其余的一切。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: This world has been uninhabited for over a billion years, so the artifacts must have been dropped here more recently.
strings.zh: 这个世界已经十亿多年无人居住了，所以这些圣物一定是较近的年代才被留在这里的。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: There is also another matter of concern here, Skars.  I show an Air Exclusion (AE) structure on that hill to the south west.
strings.zh: 这里还有另一件值得担心的事，斯卡斯。西南方那座山丘上，我探测到一座禁空（AE）结构。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.zh: 泰肯科技还是塞洛伊科技？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Neither.  This technology is actually ancient and comes from the 3rd C.E.... the civilization that came after yours.  It was supposed to be a technology to block spores, but...
strings.zh: 都不是。这项技术其实很古老，来自第3循环历……你们之后的那个文明。它本是用作阻挡孢子的技术，可……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Let me guess, it didn't block spores for long and the Creeper altered it for its own purposes.
strings.zh: 让我猜猜，它没能挡住孢子多久，Creeper就把它改成自己的用途了。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Yes, now it simply blocks your air units.  You can't use Strafers or Bombers over the area covered by the AE field.
strings.zh: 是的，现在它只挡你的空中单位。在AE场覆盖的区域内，你无法使用俯冲机或轰炸机。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Great... it will take pure ground operations to take that hill then.  Are Berthas and mortars affected?
strings.zh: 好极了……那要拿下那座山丘就只能靠纯地面作战了。贝莎炮和迫击炮受影响吗？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: No, they slip in under the field... just barely.  So you are only prevented from using Air units under the area covered by the AE field.
strings.zh: 不受影响，它们从场下方穿过……勉勉强强。所以你只是不能在AE场覆盖的区域内使用空中单位。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Let's grab the artifacts and get out of here before the whole world disintegrates...
strings.zh: 我们拿走圣物就离开这里，趁整个世界还没崩解……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I believe you are familiar with an Alien race known as the Styglek?
strings.zh: 我想你熟悉一个叫斯泰格莱克的异族吧？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Yes, they were a once powerful and noble species that fell to the Creeper and were forced to serve the Loki.  A few of them rebelled and those rebels assisted our survival against the second Nexus menace.
strings.zh: 熟悉，他们曾是强大而高贵的种族，后来败给Creeper，被迫为洛基效力。其中有少数人反叛，那些叛军帮助我们在第二次枢纽威胁中活了下来。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I believe "Thrade" was the leader of these rebels?
strings.zh: 我记得「斯雷德」是这些叛军的领袖？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: It would seem that the rebellion did not progress as originally intended.  This Message Artifact references the Styglek, Thrade, and the failed Styglek rebellion to stop the Loki.
strings.zh: 看来那场叛乱并没有按最初的设想发展。这件信息圣物提到了斯泰格莱克、斯雷德，以及那场失败了的、旨在阻止洛基的斯泰格莱克叛乱。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.zh: 这条信息是什么时候录下的？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: It is difficult to date, and very badly damaged, but it seems to have been recorded sometime after the Seloi were long gone.  Sometime around the 300th C.E. perhaps.
strings.zh: 很难确定年代，而且损毁严重，但它似乎录于塞洛伊早已消亡之后。也许在第300循环历前后。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The message is a historical volume recording the stories of a single Styglek that returned to the then Milky Way galaxy.  Most of the message is missing, but apparently one Styglek fled the destruction of their kind and returned with a message.
strings.zh: 这条信息是一卷历史记录，记述了一名回到当时银河系的斯泰格莱克的故事。大部分内容已经缺失，但显然有一名斯泰格莱克在同族覆灭时逃了出来，带着一条信息回来了。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: So the Styglek failed and were exterminated by the Loki.  Just like all things, they too eventually were destroyed.
strings.zh: 所以斯泰格莱克失败了，被洛基灭绝。就像万事万物，他们最终也被毁灭了。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: It seems more complex than that, Skars.  It would appear the Styglek eventually just ended their rebellion on their own accord.
strings.zh: 事情似乎比这复杂，斯卡斯。看起来斯泰格莱克最终是自己主动结束了叛乱。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Why, what makes you say that?
strings.zh: 为什么，你凭什么这么说？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The message the Styglek survivor carried to humanity was, "The Arc is everything... everything that ever was or will be. Once you truly comprehend this, you will free your minds from the burden of resistance.  Remember us as the ones who woke up."
strings.zh: 那名斯泰格莱克幸存者带给人类的信息是：「弧即是一切……一切曾经存在与将要存在之物。当你真正理解这一点，你的心智便会从抵抗的重负中解脱。请把我们记作那些醒来的人。」
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: One that appears to have been lost over time.  This message was recorded using a one-time pad as a key... and that key was included with this message. But, the key was written onto the message millions of years after the message was originally recorded.
strings.zh: 而这一次，似乎已随岁月湮没。这条信息是用一次性密码本作为密钥录制的……那把密钥也附在这条信息里。但那密钥是在原始录制之后数百万年，才被写上去的。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: So someone or something kept the decryption key a secret and only included it eons later.  And of course the whole thing was on an artifact the Creeper bypassed.
strings.zh: 所以是某人或某物把解密密钥藏了起来，直到万古之后才附上。而这一切当然都放在一件Creeper绕过的圣物上。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Lia.... we are on the verge of a great realization, I can feel it in my.... That's odd.
strings.zh: 莉娅……我们正处在一次重大领悟的边缘，我感觉到了，就在我的……这可真怪。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Never mind that now Skars, lets get out of here and move on to Vapen and take out the Warp Inhibitor.
strings.zh: 先别管这个了，斯卡斯，我们离开这里，转往瓦彭，端掉那座跃迁抑制器。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I was afraid of this.  I had hoped it had all been deactivated...
strings.zh: 我担心的就是这个。我本希望它已经全部停用了……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: This is Tiplex, a machine world.  It was engineered by the Ticon Empire as a defensive outpost.
strings.zh: 这里是蒂普莱克斯，一个机械世界。它由泰肯帝国建造，作为防御前哨。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The 'Ticon Empire'?  One of the many human civilizations that arose?
strings.zh: 「泰肯帝国」？兴起的人类文明之一？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Yes, they were but one civilization, but they developed in a very militaristic way.  They developed massive weapon systems. Entire planets were turned into weapons.
strings.zh: 是的，他们只是其中一个文明，但发展路线极其军事化。他们开发了庞大的武器系统。整颗整颗的星球被改造成武器。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Their conflict with the Creeper lasted centuries, longer than any other civilization.  But the costs were unthinkable.  And in the end, they failed like all the others.
strings.zh: 他们与Creeper的冲突持续了几个世纪，比任何其他文明都长。但代价无法想象。而最终，他们和所有其他文明一样失败了。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The Ticons developed a weapon system they believed would destroy the Creeper once and for all.  It was an artificial, self-replicating structure that derived its sustenance from Emitters.  It was believed this would 'immunize' worlds from Emitters.
strings.zh: 泰肯人开发了一套武器系统，相信它能一劳永逸地摧毁Creeper。那是一种人造的自我复制结构，靠发射器汲取养分。他们相信这能让世界对发射器「免疫」。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: For a while, and to a measure.  It worked until the emitters were somehow changed.  The emitters adapted to the parasite and turned this weapon, which the Ticon called "Digitalis", into an asset.  Emitters no longer appeared to lose any viability when surrounded by Digitalis.
strings.zh: 有一阵子，某种程度上。直到发射器不知怎么发生了变化。发射器适应了这个寄生物，把这件被泰肯人称为「魔苋」的武器变成了自己的资源。被魔苋包围时，发射器似乎不再损失任何活性。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: How did the Ticon people cope?
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: They didn't.  The Digitalis had allowed them to survive the Creeper for decades, but in one moment it became their undoing.  Once the emitters adapted, the Digitalis no longer destroyed them.  Instead it would grow and protect the emitters.
strings.zh: 他们没能应对。魔苋曾让他们在与Creeper的对抗中存活了几十年，但一瞬间它就成了他们的毁灭之源。发射器一旦适应，魔苋就不再摧毁它们，反而生长起来保护发射器。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: And it appears as if this Digitalis still exists...
strings.zh: 而看起来，这魔苋依然存在……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: With regret, it seems so.  Skars, the Digitalis is a brutish and simple enemy.  It spreads along predefined pathways.  But, those paths don't respect terrain elevation.  Digitalis is tough, very tough, and your weapons will have difficulty damaging it.
strings.zh: 很遗憾，看来是的。斯卡斯，魔苋是个粗暴而简单的敌人。它沿着预设路径蔓延。但这些路径不受地形高度限制。魔苋很坚韧，极其坚韧，你的武器很难伤到它。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: What is worse is that The Digitalis replicates rapidly and will fill in destroyed areas with great efficiency.  Your best strategy is to try to cut it off from its source.  Digitalis requires a connection to an emitter to thrive.  If you sever that connection, it will cease to grow and eventually wither.
strings.zh: 更糟的是，魔苋复制极快，会以极高的效率填补被摧毁的区域。你最好的策略是设法切断它与源头。魔苋需要与发射器相连才能繁盛。一旦切断那连接，它就会停止生长，最终枯萎。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Digitalis also conducts Creeper rapidly and with no loss. So beware of this as it can move Creeper over higher terrain.
strings.zh: 魔苋还能快速无损地传导Creeper。所以要小心，它能把Creeper送过高地。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: If it conducts Creeper, then I suppose Anti-Creeper is also conducted by it?
