strings.zh: 如果它能传导Creeper，那我猜Anti-Creeper也能被它传导？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Indeed.  Anti-Creeper is conducted as well.  Anti-Creeper also slows the regeneration of Digitalis, so use that to your advantage when possible.
strings.zh: 确实。Anti-Creeper同样能被传导。Anti-Creeper还会减缓魔苋的再生，所以有机会就利用这一点。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I see there is a Tech Artifact on this world.  It appears it will allow the control of a second Command Node...
strings.zh: 我看到这个世界有一个技术圣物。看起来它能让人控制第二个指挥节点……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: This will be indispensable on this mission, Skars.  Collect that tech artifact, then land a second Command Node.  This will allow a two front approach and you may be able to take out the emitters that are sourcing the Digitalis.
strings.zh: 这次任务中它不可或缺，斯卡斯。取回那个技术圣物，然后降落第二个指挥节点。这样你就能两线并进，也许可以打掉为魔苋供源的发射器。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: This is most unusual, Skars.  Message Artifacts almost never survive contact with the Creeper.  This one seems strangely immune. It's almost as if the Creeper intentionally does not destroy certain objects.
strings.zh: 这非常不寻常，斯卡斯。信息圣物几乎从不能在接触Creeper后留存。这一个却奇怪地免疫。几乎像是Creeper有意不摧毁某些东西。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I will require some time to process the contents, it isn't exactly encrypted but it isn't in any recognized format either.  I should have it processed by the time we reach the next star system...
strings.zh: 我需要一些时间处理其中的内容。它算不上加密，但也不属于任何已知格式。等我们抵达下一个星系时，我应该就处理好了……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Welcome back to the next simulation map. This map is Simulation Number 57958425. Please Enjoy!
strings.zh: 欢迎回到下一张模拟地图。本图模拟编号57958425。祝你玩得愉快！
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: CAIN, I need a status report of this world.
strings.zh: CAIN，给我这个世界的状况报告。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: This world is fittly titled, "Hopping" it has several different islands, all of which have some sort of enemy presense.
strings.zh: 这个世界名字起得很贴切——「跳跃」。它有好几座不同的岛屿，每一座都有某种敌方存在。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: According to my scanners, the best place to land would be on the bottom left area because the emitter appears to be damaged and won't start untill 60 seconds after we land.
strings.zh: 根据我的扫描，最佳降落点是左下方区域，因为那里的发射器似乎受损，要等我们降落60秒后才会启动。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Thank you CAIN, I will proceed with caution.
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Oh My... this world is Ormos. It was occupied by the very last human civilization.  That civilization went to extreme and extraordinary measures to survive the Creeper.
strings.zh: 天啊……这颗星球是奥尔莫斯。它曾被最后的人类文明占据。那个文明为了在Creeper之下存活，采取了极端而惊人的手段。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I don't understand why so many civilizations would rise and fall.  How was the Creeper always able to return?
strings.zh: 我不明白为什么那么多文明兴起又覆灭。Creeper怎么总能卷土重来？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Patience.  Extreme patience.  When a civilization has existed for hundreds of thousands, even millions of years with no hint of the Creeper, it forgets.
strings.zh: 耐心。极端的耐心。当一个文明存在了几十万年、甚至几百万年，都没见到Creeper的踪影，它就会遗忘。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: So the Loki would just wait?  After eons had passed, they would send the Creeper again?
strings.zh: 所以洛基就只是等？等万古过去，再把Creeper放出来？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en:
That was one component to their strategy...
Skars, this world was altered during the final conflict.  It was a military outpost specifically designed to withstand the Creeper.
strings.zh:
那只是他们战略的一部分……
斯卡斯，这颗星球在最终之战中被改造过。它是一座专为抵御Creeper而设计的军事前哨站。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Scanners show no emitters on this world.  It must have worked somehow!
strings.zh: 扫描仪显示这颗星球上没有发射器。它当年一定起了作用！
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: So they thought.  There are no emitters but there is still Creeper.  It is trapped inside a subspace rift and will explode onto the terrain once activity is detected.
strings.zh: 他们是这么想的。没有发射器，可Creeper仍在。它被封在一个亚空间裂隙里，一旦探测到活动，就会喷涌到地表上。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The final humans here managed to alter some physical constants in this region of space.  As such, the Creeper flows more slowly than normal.
strings.zh: 这里最后的人类设法改动了这片空间的一些物理常数。因此，Creeper的流动比正常情况更慢。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: With no emitters, our only goal is to collect the Tech Artifacts and the Shield Key.  I'll get to that...
strings.zh: 既然没有发射器，我们唯一的目标就是收集技术圣物和护盾钥匙。我会去办……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Yes, but Skars... don't underestimate this Creeper.  The Tech Artifacts here are for a Siphon and a Terp.  The siphon will let you extract resources from Resource Packs.
strings.zh: 是的，不过斯卡斯……别小看这些Creeper。这里的技术圣物对应虹吸器和挖掘机。虹吸器能让你从资源包中提取资源。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Even after all these eons, there are still some Energy Packs on this world.  Build siphons on them as soon as possible to access their energy.
strings.zh: 即便过了这么多个纪元，这颗星球上仍有一些能量包。尽快在它们上面建虹吸器，取用其中的能量。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The Terp will allow you to terraform the land.  I recommend you repair the damage to the walls of the old ruins.  That will keep the Creeper at bay while you build up offensive strength.
strings.zh: 挖掘机让你能改造地形。我建议你修复古废墟城墙上的破损。这样在你积累进攻力量时，能把Creeper挡在外面。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Once you build a Terp, the Terraform Section of your Command Interface will appear.  Just click that button and paint the terrain in a few places to raise or lower it.  Any nearby Terps will then go to work.
strings.zh: 建好挖掘机后，你的指挥界面会出现地形改造栏。点那个按钮，在几处地形上涂抹，升高或降低它。附近的挖掘机就会开工。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Alright, Lia.  Let's get this done.
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Welcome to the Alpha Sector!  Here you will find a collection of varied and assorted worlds. These maps were made throughout the development of the game by beta testers.
strings.zh: 欢迎来到阿尔法星区！这里汇集了形形色色、各式各样的世界。这些地图贯穿整个游戏开发过程，由测试员们制作。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Some maps remain in their original form, others have been updated over time, yet others were updated at the end of game development by the beta testers.
strings.zh: 有些地图保持着原本的模样，有些则随时间推移被更新过，还有一些是在游戏开发末期由测试员们翻新的。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: You will find simple worlds, large worlds, super hard hards, testing worlds, puzzle words, maybe even impossible worlds.  Good luck on your journey!
strings.zh: 你会遇到简单的世界、庞大的世界、难到离谱的世界、测试世界、解谜世界，甚至可能还有根本打不过去的世界。祝旅途顺利！
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Very nice, now I'm alone and I have no idea what to do.
strings.zh: 很好，现在只剩我一个，完全不知道该干什么。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Don't worry my friend. Follow my instructions and you'll be fine.
strings.zh: 别担心，朋友。照我说的做，你就没事。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Land a command node on the central island and build up a base. Attack the four infested islands one by one and take out the structures built there.
strings.zh: 把指挥节点降落到中央岛上，建起基地。逐个进攻那四座被侵蚀的岛，摧毁上面建起的建筑。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Keep defending you base be prepared for enemies of all kinds attacking your base. When you take out one of the four structures, the tower circling around your base will take over it's function.
strings.zh: 守住基地，时刻准备迎击各种敌人的进攻。摧毁四座建筑中的一座后，环绕你基地的那座塔就会接管它的功能。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Addictionally, when you nullify one of the four structures, all units on those four islands will die immediatly. Once you've nullified them all, you can take advantages of the totems and power zones.
strings.zh: 另外，灭除四座建筑中的任意一座时，那四座岛上的所有单位都会立刻死亡。等全部灭除完毕，你就能利用图腾和能量区了。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: 2 emitters should appear the the big rocks on the left and the right. Destroy those and you'll pass this test.
strings.zh: 左右两边的巨石处应该会出现2个发射器。摧毁它们，你就通过这次测试了。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Ough, updated systems to handle all the new signals coming from this world. Finally figured them out.
strings.zh: 唔，把系统更新了一下，好处理这个世界发来的各种新信号。总算搞明白了。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: This world is unstable. Build all units in your main base in the center and be prepared to lose all units on other islands. Also remember that before you nullify a tower, make sure your main base is pretty well defended.
strings.zh: 这个世界不稳定。把所有单位都造在中央的主基地，并且做好其他岛上单位全部损失的心理准备。另外记住，灭除一座塔之前，务必确保主基地防守得足够牢固。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Isn't it easier to just sit down and do nothing?
strings.zh: 干坐着什么都不做，不是更省事吗？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: No, creeper will pile up and it will take much longer to nulllify the structures. So land down a command node and start building!
strings.zh: 不行，Creeper会越堆越多，灭除建筑会拖得久得多。所以，空降指挥节点，开始建造吧！
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: These space islands remind me of frosting cookies as a child
strings.zh: 这些太空岛屿让我想起小时候给饼干抹糖霜。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: You are quickly coming to recognize worlds... good.  This world was used by the Ticon Empire, but it appears to be more than a simple outpost.
strings.zh: 你辨认星球越来越快了……很好。这颗星球曾属于泰肯帝国，但它看起来不只是一座简单的前哨站。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: There is a large structure to the south east and what look like old Totems to the north west? Totems?
strings.zh: 东南方有个大型建筑，西北方那些像是古老的图腾？图腾？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Yes, Totems from your age.  Your people used Totems to open rifts into Rift-Space.  But, Rift-Space was long ago destroyed, and the Ticons had a hand in that.
strings.zh: 是的，你那个时代的图腾。你的族人用图腾打开通往裂隙空间的裂隙。但裂隙空间早已被毁，泰肯人参与其中。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Totems were built by the Ticon people to produce Aether.  Aether is formed from the remnants of Rift-Space, so Totems are able to extract it.
strings.zh: 图腾是泰肯人建造来生产以太的。以太由裂隙空间的残骸形成，所以图腾能够把它提取出来。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: That large structure, do you recognize it?  How does it relate to the Totems?
strings.zh: 那座大型建筑，你认得吗？它和图腾有什么关系？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: It appears to be a Ticon Forge.  I've scanned the schematics so will need some time to fully process them.  But, take control of that structure and we should be able to upgrade various capabilities.
strings.zh: 看起来是一座泰肯锻造厂。我已经扫描了图纸，需要一些时间才能完全解析。但拿下那座建筑，我们就能升级多种能力。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The Forge will require Aether, so secure and supply energy to those Totems once you secure the Forge.
strings.zh: 锻造厂需要以太，所以拿下锻造厂之后，确保那些图腾的安全并向它们供能。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Upgrade?  Weapons, production, packet speed, things like that I hope...?
strings.zh: 升级？希望是武器、生产、能量包速度之类的东西……？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Precisely things like that.  I'll need time to bring all of the systems on-line, Skars.  So you will have limited upgrades on this world, but what I am able to bring on-line should prove useful.
strings.zh: 正是那类东西。我需要时间让所有系统上线，斯卡斯。所以在这颗星球上你的升级会有限，但能上线的那部分应该会有用。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I don't see much of great difficulty here, just a couple emitters around the Forge and the Totems.  I should be able to rush in without issue.
strings.zh: 这里我看不出太大难度，只有几个发射器分布在锻造厂和图腾周围。我应该能顺利冲进去。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: There is a Ticon structure in that base area to the north east.  Be very cautious, some of the things they experimented with were very dangerous.  If that structure is still active, it may defend itself.
strings.zh: 东北方那片基地里有一座泰肯建筑。务必小心，他们实验过的某些东西极其危险。如果那座建筑仍在运作，它可能会自卫。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: It has also been compromised by the Creeper, so whatever it originally did it's a safe bet it does something that benefits the Creeper now.
strings.zh: 它也被Creeper侵蚀了，所以无论它原本做什么，现在多半在做对Creeper有利的事。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Alright Lia, I'll proceed with caution and secure this world.
strings.zh: 好，莉娅。我会谨慎推进，拿下这颗星球。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: This 'warp' travel is strange to me...
strings.zh: 这种「跃迁」旅行对我来说很陌生……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Yes, you only ever knew travel through Rift Space.  Rift Space was sealed many millennia ago in an attempt to stop the Creeper menace from returning.
strings.zh: 是啊，你从前只知道通过裂隙空间旅行。许多个千年前，裂隙空间被封印，为的是阻止Creeper的威胁再度降临。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Unfortunately, it did not work.  The Creeper arrived in vessels that could bend the fabric of space-time.  Eventually, the few survivors of successive civilizations developed their own warp technology.
strings.zh: 不幸的是，那没有用。Creeper乘着能扭曲时空结构的飞船来了。最终，一个个文明余下的少数幸存者，各自发展出了跃迁技术。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: But no matter how strong and advanced each civilization grew, the Creeper would always eventually return.
strings.zh: 可无论每个文明变得多么强大、多么先进，Creeper终究会卷土重来。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: But this ship was constructed before those events.  Platius must have known about warp travel and that this ship would need it.
strings.zh: 但这艘船是在那些事之前建造的。普拉提乌斯一定知道跃迁旅行，也知道这艘船用得上。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Yes, but... things weren't that simple.  For now concentrate on gaining access to Starsync.  That's where the Warp Inhibitor is in this system.
strings.zh: 是的，不过……事情没那么简单。眼下先想办法进入「星同步」。这个星系的跃迁抑制器就在那儿。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I see it at 'Starsync' but it is shielded....  The threat these people faced must have been truly terrifying.  Looks like Telos is our only option.  I'll fly the ship there and initiate ground actions.
strings.zh: 我在「星同步」看到它了，但那里有护盾……这些人当年面对的威胁，一定真的恐怖至极。看来「泰洛斯」是我们唯一的选择。我把船飞过去，发起地面行动。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Scanners are showing something I have not seen before...  I'm checking on it now commander.
strings.zh: 扫描仪上显示着我从没见过的东西……我正在核查，指挥官。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Scan complete: This area has underground tunnels that emitters will use to dig their way to the surface like in CW2.
strings.zh: 扫描完成：这片区域有地下隧道，发射器会像在CW2里那样，沿着隧道挖到地表。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Is CW2 a designation for some other planet? Nevermind, what do you suggest we do?
strings.zh: CW2是另一颗星球的编号吗？算了，你建议我们怎么做？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: It appears you can use TERPs to slow down their digging procedure, or to cover a hole left behind a nullified emitter.  Also the emitters will use the tunnels to release creeper in other locations.
strings.zh: 看来你可以用挖掘机拖慢它们的挖掘进程，或者填平被灭除的发射器留下的坑洞。还有，发射器会借隧道在其他位置释放Creeper。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Another shattered world.  The last I heard from this world, it was a thriving new colony.  There is likely little here of interest.
strings.zh: 又一颗破碎的星球。我上次收到这颗星球的讯息时，它还是一座蓬勃发展的新殖民地。这里恐怕没什么值得留意的了。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Don't be so hasty... your Gel circuits must need recalibrating.  I see a Message Artifact and a Tech Artifact on the scanners.
strings.zh: 别这么急……你的凝胶回路该重新校准了。我在扫描器上看到一件信息圣物和一件技术圣物。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Yes.... yes... you are correct.  Not sure why I overlooked those.  Perhaps I need to perform Gel maintenance again.
strings.zh: 对……对……你说得对。不知我为什么漏掉了它们。也许我该再做一次凝胶维护了。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: There also appears to be an odd anomaly in space.  Subspace-slip emitters appear to be floating between the asteroids and space seems warped there!
strings.zh: 太空中似乎还有一处奇怪的异常。亚空间滑移发射器漂浮在小行星之间，那里的空间像是被扭曲了！
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I have few records of the Creeper ever acting in this fashion.  It is possible to warp space this way, but so far from a gravity well... it would require immense energy.  The mass energy of entire stars would be required....
strings.zh: 关于Creeper有过这种行为，我的记录寥寥无几。这样扭曲空间是可能的，但离引力井如此之远……那需要极其庞大的能量。得耗尽好几颗恒星的质量能量才够……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I can only recommend that you stay clear of that area.  With that much Creeper collapsing into a small region of space, I'm not sure what the results might be.
strings.zh: 我只能建议你远离那片区域。那么多Creeper向一小片空间坍缩，我无法确定会有什么后果。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The Tech Artifact doesn't show any signatures of Ticon or any other civilization we have encountered.... it appears to be a rather mundane tech.
strings.zh: 那件技术圣物上没有任何泰肯的标记，也没有我们遇到过的其他文明的标记……看起来是相当普通的技术。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The Guppy tech... I have been hoping we would encounter this.  Simple as the tech may be, it should prove very useful across these asteroids.  Guppies confine and contain packets for remote delivery.
strings.zh: 补给船技术……我一直盼着我们能遇上这个。这技术或许简单，但在这些小行星之间会非常有用。补给船能约束并封装能量包，用于远程投送。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Ahhh... very clever.  So we can use them to build structures remotely where our network can't reach.  That will allow us to build nullifiers on those small asteroids that have Spore Towers on them.
strings.zh: 啊……非常巧妙。这样我们就能在网络的触角达不到的地方远程建造设施。那我们就能在那些带孢子塔的小行星上建造灭除器了。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Speaking of Spore Towers, my circuits are now operating properly and I have reviewed the scans. The wreckage of this world is littered with Spore Towers.  You will need to bring Beam defenses on-line rapidly. Collect the Guppy Tech Artifact, and eliminate the spore threat as soon as possible.
strings.zh: 说到孢子塔，我的回路现在运作正常了，我也复核了扫描结果。这颗星球的残骸中散布着孢子塔。你需要尽快让光束防御上线。取走补给船技术圣物，尽快消除孢子威胁。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I have also managed to enable a few more tech upgrades in the Forge.  Use those to your advantage.
strings.zh: 我还设法在锻造厂里启用了若干科技升级。好好利用它们。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I'm glad your circuits are working well again... I hope that whatever spatial anomalies are present in this system aren't affecting you...
strings.zh: 很高兴你的回路又恢复正常了……希望这个星系里的空间异常没有影响到你……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: This is fascinating...  This artifact contains an instruction manual for the Guppy, volumes of literature, art, and video from old Earth, and a treatise from the 144th C.E. on the prospects of cyclical eternity.
strings.zh: 这真有趣……这件圣物里存着补给船的操作手册、来自旧地球的成卷文学、艺术与影像资料，还有一篇写于第144循环历、探讨循环永恒之可能性的论文。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: An odd collection of materials?  Scan through it all looking for anything unusual.
strings.zh: 一堆奇怪的资料？全部扫一遍，找出任何异常之处。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The treatise on cyclical eternity was written during the time of the Seloi, the sole civilization that ever contacted the Loki.  The treatise proposes something that is most certainly impossible.
strings.zh: 那篇关于循环永恒的论文写于塞洛伊时代，那是唯一与洛基接触过的文明。论文提出了一个毫无疑问绝无可能的东西。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The Seloi were prone to works of great imagination and often developed entire disciplines devoted to the study of theories they knew to be false.  So this is likely one of their many fanciful creations.
strings.zh: 塞洛伊人偏爱极富想象力的作品，还常常发展出整套学科，专门研究他们明知为伪的理论。所以这很可能只是他们众多奇思异想的产物之一。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Be that as it may, indulge me with some details.
strings.zh: 即便如此，也请迁就我，讲些细节。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The treatise proposes that our universe is but one of many... nothing new there, this idea dates back to the 1st C.E.  It goes on to argue that it is possible to create a device... something unique and singular to each universe.
strings.zh: 论文提出，我们的宇宙只是众多宇宙之一……这倒不新鲜，这种想法可以追溯到第1循环历。它接着论证，可以制造出一种装置……一种每个宇宙都独有而唯一的东西。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Unfortunately, the document stops after that and no more details are available.  It looks simply like the message was cut off.
strings.zh: 可惜文档到那里就断了，再没有更多细节。看起来就是讯息被截断了。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Any hints of where the rest of the message may be?
strings.zh: 有没有线索指向讯息的其余部分在哪里？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Nothing.  In all likelihood, this was a partial copy and the rest of the treatise is lost forever.
strings.zh: 没有。这很可能只是一份残缺的副本，论文的其余部分已经永远失传了。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: This pit is full of moving drone-bases. Some structures might even create drone-bases.
strings.zh: 这个坑里满是移动的无人机基地。有些建筑甚至会生成无人机基地。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The drones will destroy any structure in range immediatly. They will move freely over the map but prefer high ground, but not higher than 8. Try to get them trapped so you can nullify the drone-bases.
strings.zh: 无人机一旦进入射程，就会立刻摧毁任何建筑。它们在地图上自由移动，偏好高地，但不会高于8层。试着把它们困住，这样你就能灭除那些无人机基地。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Next dialog will show a hint, click skip all if you don't want a spoiler.
strings.zh: 下一段对话会给出提示。不想被剧透的话，点「跳过全部」。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: This is our testing facility. Here you can test out weapons and discover the power of powerzones. Spores can get pretty intense here so make sure you build a few more beams.
strings.zh: 这里是我们的试验场。你可以在此试用各种武器，体验供能区的威力。这里的孢子会很猛，所以记得多造几道光束。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Scanners show a strange kind of enemy and I don't know what it will do.
strings.zh: 扫描仪显示有一种奇怪的敌人，我不知道它会做什么。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: So I just have to sit and watch? Not a really good option.
strings.zh: 那我就只能干看着？这可不算是好选择。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Well, it will send a large wall of creeper to you. I recommend building stuff that can withstand some creeper or kill the creeper before it reaches you. Remember that units in flight can't get damaged.
strings.zh: 嗯，它会朝你推来一大堵Creeper墙。我建议造些能扛住Creeper的东西，或者在Creeper过来之前就把它消灭。记住，飞行中的单位不会受伤。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Telos... this is a world that has been silent for over 100 thousand earth standard years.
strings.zh: 泰洛斯……这是一个沉寂了超过十万地球标准年的世界。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Lia, do you have any additional information about why I was brought to this time?  It seems as if the Creeper has destroyed everything we ever worked to save...
strings.zh: 莉娅，你有更多关于我被带到这个时代的资料吗？看起来Creeper已经毁掉了我们曾为之奋斗的一切……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I only have the star map we are following.  If more information is available, it is locked away and inaccessible in my gel circuits.
strings.zh: 我只有我们正在追踪的星图。如果还有更多信息，它被锁在我的凝胶回路上，无法访问。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: (Perhaps this is my punishment.  Perhaps I died many years ago...  could this be the mythological cursed realm of Helheim my ancestors believed in? Impossible...)
strings.zh: （也许这就是我的惩罚。也许我很多年前就已经死了……这会不会是我的祖先所信仰的、神话中受诅咒的冥界海尔海姆？不可能……）
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Skars, there is a Reactor Tech Artifact on this world.  Pick that up as soon as possible.  We can use it to generate energy in confined regions.
strings.zh: 斯卡斯，这个星球上有一个反应堆技术圣物。尽快取回它。我们可以用它在地形受限的区域发电。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I see there is also a shield key here.  I'll destroy the three emitters and collect that key...
strings.zh: 我看到这里还有一把护盾钥匙。我会摧毁那三个发射器，然后取回钥匙……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Welcome Back to the Custom Map Series, Simulation. This map is number 258685432. Please Enjoy, it is titled, "The Name".
strings.zh: 欢迎回到自定义地图系列，模拟。本图编号258685432。请尽情享受，它的标题是「The Name」。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: This world looks to have an interesting shape in it... "Lich" I wonder what that means.
strings.zh: 这个世界里似乎有个有趣的形状……「Lich」，不知道那是什么意思。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Records indicate that this world was based off of a privatly owned planet build to defend against the creeper, unforutonly it failed and proved very hard to take back.
strings.zh: 记录显示，这个世界是以一颗私人星球为原型建造的，用来抵御Creeper，可惜它失败了，而且极难夺回。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The world is covered with lots of enemy units. Be prepared to fight quickly, and smartly!
strings.zh: 这个世界布满了大量敌方单位。做好准备，打得快，也打得巧！
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The first mission from the old alpha versions that seemed impossible. Good luck!
strings.zh: 旧版alpha时期的第一个任务，当年看起来根本不可能完成。祝好运！
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: We hope you will enjoy your stay, and wish you luck on your training!
strings.zh: 希望你能待得愉快，也祝你在训练中好运！
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: You no doubt remember one epoch of this world.  Far York was a mighty world and served as the center of commerce for 13 different civilizations.
strings.zh: 你无疑记得这个世界的一个纪元。远约克曾是一个强大的世界，是13个不同文明的贸易中心。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: It's nothing but cratered ruins now.
strings.zh: 如今只剩下布满坑洞的废墟。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Toward the end of its final occupation, the surviving humans scorched the planet with orbital mass drivers. It was an effort to... I suppose it doesn't matter now.
strings.zh: 在它最后一次被占据的末期，幸存的人类用轨道质量驱动器焚烧了这颗星球。那是一次为了……我想现在已经无关紧要了。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Scanners show a Mortar Tech Artifact on this world.  That should prove very useful against the emitters in the craters.
strings.zh: 扫描仪显示这颗星球上有一件迫击炮技术圣物。对付坑洞里的发射器，那应该非常有用。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Why isn't this ship already equipped with this weapon technology?
strings.zh: 为什么这艘船没有配备这种武器技术？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: It once was, but many things happened over the course of billions of years.  This ship isn't the original, I have had to reconstruct and rebuild it many times.  Each reconstruction was performed carefully and slowly, so as to not be discovered.
strings.zh: 它曾经有，但在数十亿年的历程中发生了太多事。这艘船不是最初那一艘，我不得不反复重建、重造它许多次。每一次重建都进行得谨慎而缓慢，以免被发现。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I'll ask more about that later.  For now, lets take out these emitters and pick up that shield key.
strings.zh: 这个我以后再细问。现在，先把这些发射器解决掉，把那把护盾钥匙拿到手。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: At last, we have lowered the shield and gained access to this world.  Lia, perform a quick scan.  What are the Loki up to?
strings.zh: 终于，我们降下了护盾，得以进入这个世界。莉娅，快速扫描一次。洛基在搞什么？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I detect no Loki, or other life forms.  Everything here is an automated machine system.  It's a massive effort, though.
strings.zh: 我没有探测到洛基，也没有其他生命形式。这里的一切都是自动化的机械系统。不过，这项工程的规模极其庞大。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: What is going on, what is being built?
strings.zh: 出了什么事，在建造什么？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Give me a moment...  This isn't good at all.  I think I understand part of what is going on.
strings.zh: 给我一点时间……这可不妙。我想我明白了一部分情况。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: There are automated ore harvesters here that are constructing a 'Prism' ship.  That ship's sole purpose is to focus Aether from a Totem.  Several civilizations experimented with this kind of tech but on a much smaller scale...
strings.zh: 这里有自动化的矿石采集器，正在建造一艘「棱镜」飞船。那艘船的唯一用途就是聚焦来自图腾的以太。有几个文明试验过这类技术，但规模要小得多……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Whoever designed this ship has managed to create a massive Prism ship.  There is also a heavily altered Totem in the north east.  It's covered by some protective armor as well.
strings.zh: 设计这艘船的人成功造出了一艘巨型棱镜飞船。东北方还有一座被大幅改造过的图腾。它还覆盖着一层防护装甲。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: What good does focusing Aether do?
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Nothing on a small scale.  On a large scale... Ah, I see now.  The signals in this system are focused on this world for a reason.  This is elegant beyond anything I have ever experienced.
strings.zh: 小规模的话毫无用处。大规模……啊，我现在明白了。这个星系里的信号之所以集中在这个世界，是有原因的。这优雅得超出了我所经历的一切。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The signals present in this system are near the information capacity for this region of space, it wouldn't be possible to put more information in a volume of space bounded by a smaller surface area...
strings.zh: 这个星系中现有的信号已接近这片空间的信息容量上限，在一个由更小表面积包围的空间体积里，不可能再塞进更多信息……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The only way to get more information density is to increase the apparent surface area of space and Aether is extra-dimensional....
strings.zh: 要想提高信息密度，唯一的办法就是增大空间的表观表面积，而以太是超维度的……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: So that Prism ship can receive the signals being directed at this system, then pack the information into a smaller region of space than is otherwise possible?
strings.zh: 所以那艘棱镜飞船可以接收射向这个星系的信号，然后把信息压缩进比通常可能达到的更小的空间区域？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: And then it is my suspicion that it will transmit all of that information via an Aether beam through the remnants of Rift space.  That's the only purpose I can foresee.  I do believe the results of this transmission will have one other effect...
strings.zh: 然后我怀疑，它会通过一道以太光束，穿过裂隙空间的残迹把全部信息传送出去。这是我能预见的唯一用途。不过我相信，这次传送的结果还会带来另一个效应……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: If that Prism Ship is allowed to launch and create an Aether Beam over the enhanced Totem in the north east... if that happens... the resulting Aether back-blast will destroy this entire star system.
strings.zh: 如果放任那艘棱镜飞船升空，在东北方那座强化图腾上方形成一道以太光束……如果那真的发生……由此产生的以太反冲将摧毁整个星系。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Well, we better not let that happen Lia.  Perhaps if we destroy this ship it will also cripple whatever the Loki are trying to accomplish.
strings.zh: 那我们最好别让它发生，莉娅。也许摧毁这艘船，也能一并挫败洛基想要达成的事。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I wish I could concur, Skars.  But based on what we saw on Otrav, the amount of information in the signals, and the size of this facility.... I...
strings.zh: 我希望我能同意你，斯卡斯。但根据我们在奥特拉夫所见、信号中的信息量，以及这座设施的规模……我……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I believe this world is but one of perhaps millions like it.  Skars, the visible universe must be covered with millions of worlds just like this one all building Prism Ships to focus information and transmit it.
strings.zh: 我相信这个世界只是也许数百万个同类世界中的一个。斯卡斯，可观测宇宙里一定布满了数百万个和这里一样的星球，全都在建造棱镜飞船，用来聚焦并传送信息。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: (Sigh)... This is all so much bigger than us, Lia.  How can we ever hope to stop this....?
strings.zh: （叹气）……这一切都远比我们庞大，莉娅。我们怎么可能还指望阻止它……？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: We can start by surviving here and now.  If we don't destroy that Prism Ship, we will most certainly be destroyed.
strings.zh: 我们可以从活过此时此刻开始。如果不摧毁那艘棱镜飞船，我们必将被摧毁。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Alright Lia, tomorrow holds little promise, but today won't be our final day.  I promise you that.
strings.zh: 好吧，莉娅。明天没什么指望，但今天不会是我们最后一天。我向你保证。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Oh this is bad.... There are a ton of emitters here.. and there is no safe location to start operating from...
strings.zh: 哦，这可不妙……这里发射器多得数不清……而且根本没有安全的地方可以作为行动的起点……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Commander, that Emitter on the Black Rock seems to emit Anti-Creeper
strings.zh: 指挥官，黑岩上那座发射器喷出的好像是Anti-Creeper。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: What?! How it comes it does that...
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Hey there young girl... I guess you wouldn't remember me at the moment. Commander, take care of her, she'll be important as soon as her memories come back. She got the same foe as you...
strings.zh: 嘿，小姑娘……我猜你现在记不起我了。指挥官，照顾好她，等她的记忆回来，她会很重要。她和你有同一个敌人……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I... I know that guy... ... ... urgh... I'm sorry...
strings.zh: 我……我认识那个人…………呃……对不起……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en:
... He doesn't look too friendly... on the other hand, he's just about saving us... so I will take back my questions... for the moment...
The same foe? The Creeper, but which human does not fight them, heh?
strings.zh:
……他看起来可不怎么友善……不过话说回来，他正要救我们……所以我把问题收回来……暂时……
同一个敌人？Creeper吗，可哪个人类不在跟它们打呢，嘿？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Just like you she is after their most powerful Nexus. At that moment, I want to hope you're doing better as she has done back then...
strings.zh: 和你一样，她盯上的是它们最强大的枢纽。到那时候，我希望你干得比她当年更好……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en:
She already fought that Nexus? How it comes?
And if she ... failed, how did she survive that?
strings.zh:
她已经打过那个枢纽了？怎么会？
还有，如果她……失败了，她又是怎么活下来的？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Patience, Commander. You'll know it all when you need to, or when she remembers. For now, you're better off charging a Nexus, right? For your own sake, trust me once. These Coordinates lead to the only gate to it's Realm.
strings.zh: 耐心点，指挥官。等该知道的时候，或者等她记起来的时候，你自然全都会知道。眼下，你更该做的是去冲击一个枢纽，对吧？为你自己好，就信我一次。这些坐标通向它领域的唯一一道门。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en:
I wonder if.... You may call me Zantaros.
Let's see, any reaction...?
strings.zh:
我在想会不会……你可以叫我赞塔罗斯。
来看看，有什么反应吗……？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Zantaros...? Sounds familiar.... I ... I think we can trust him... at least for the moment...
strings.zh: 赞塔罗斯……？听着耳熟……我……我想我们可以信他……至少眼下可以……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I want to hope you're right. We did never yet find a way to charge that Nexus, so I'm willing to do anything. If this is a trap, be sure we will hunt you down.
strings.zh: 我希望你说得对。我们一直没找到冲击那个枢纽的办法，所以我什么都愿意试。如果这是个陷阱，你最好相信我们会把你揪出来。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Well, the young girl remembers at least something. I am quite sure, the next time we meet she will know me again... I will leave this Emitter here, maybe it helps you...
strings.zh: 嗯，小姑娘至少还记得点什么。我很确定，下次见面时她会重新认出我……这座发射器我就留在这儿，也许能帮上你们……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: This system looks nearly empty.  It almost looks like a place forgotten by time...
strings.zh: 这个星系看上去几乎空空如也。简直像是被时间遗忘的地方……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: This system once hosted many planets and was a center of commerce, entertainment, and industry.  But over time it all faded.  With each passing civilization, fewer and fewer worlds were recolonized.
strings.zh: 这个星系曾经拥有众多行星，是商业、娱乐与工业的中心。但日积月累，一切都衰败了。随着一个又一个文明的更替，被重新殖民的世界越来越少。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Eventually, most of the worlds were destroyed, or deorbited.  Now, only one world remains.
strings.zh: 最终，多数世界被摧毁，或被脱轨。如今只剩下一个世界。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I see this world is Inhibiting further warp travel, though the readings are strange.  What lies beyond this system?
strings.zh: 我看这个世界正在抑制进一步的跃迁航行，不过读数很古怪。这个星系之外是什么？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: It's a wormhole to the Prospector Zone!  I lost track of this wormhole many eons ago.  I see it parked itself outside this little system.
strings.zh: 那是通往探矿者区的虫洞！我很久很久以前就失去了这个虫洞的踪迹。看来它把自己停在了这个小星系外面。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: This zone was a region of space known to later civilizations as a place of great riches and unknowns.  The wormhole leading to it was discovered in the early Common Eras and different civilizations would use the worlds in various ways.
strings.zh: 这片区域被后来的文明视为一个充满巨大财富与未知的地方。通往那里的虫洞是在公共纪元早期被发现的，不同的文明会以各种方式利用那里的世界。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Some civilizations would place their most valuable weapons there, and others would go there to retrieve those same weapons....
strings.zh: 有些文明会把最宝贵的武器存放在那里，另一些文明则会去那里取走同样的武器……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I'll engage operations at Krig and take out whatever is inhibiting further warp travel.
strings.zh: 我会在克里格展开行动，干掉任何阻碍进一步跃迁的东西。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: There is also a shield key on Krig, so collect that.
strings.zh: 克里格上还有一把护盾钥匙，顺手收走。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I'll do that.  Perhaps we can return later and explore the region of space on the other end of that wormhole.  For now, I sense our mission lies elsewhere.
strings.zh: 我会的。也许我们以后能回来，探索那个虫洞另一端的星域。眼下，我感觉我们的任务在别处。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: At last, we have access to the Inhibitor in this system.  Unfortunately, this world is a disaster.
strings.zh: 终于，我们能接触到这个星系里的抑制器了。不幸的是，这个世界已是一片废墟。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: It appears terrible weapons were used that ripped the world apart.  As you are seeing, humanity went to every extreme in its fight with the Creeper.
strings.zh: 看起来是某种可怕的武器把这个星球撕裂了。如你所见，人类在与Creeper的战斗中走到了每一种极端。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The nightmare these people must have experienced... unimaginable.
strings.zh: 这些人所经历的噩梦……难以想象。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I'm not sure what approach would be best here Skars.... wait, I detect two Tech Artifacts.  Excellent....
strings.zh: 我不确定在这里该采取哪种方式，斯卡斯……等等，我探测到两个技术圣物。太好了……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I see them on the scanners.  Ore Miner and Sprayer?
strings.zh: 我在扫描仪上看到了。矿场和喷吐者？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Yes, build ore mines on those ore deposits you see.  They will send ore to the Command Node.  From there, it will be processed into Anti-Creeper.
strings.zh: 是的，在那些你看到的矿藏上建矿场。它们会把矿石送往指挥节点。在那里，矿石会被加工成Anti-Creeper。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en:
Ahhh yes, Anti-Creeper.  It was my daughter Alia.... (sigh)
It was my daughter Aliana, who unlocked the secrets of Anti-Creeper long ago.
strings.zh:
啊，对，Anti-Creeper。是我的女儿阿利娅……（叹气）
是我的女儿阿利安娜，很久以前揭开了Anti-Creeper的秘密。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I assume the Sprayer will deliver Anti-Creeper to the battlefield?
strings.zh: 我猜喷吐者会把Anti-Creeper送上战场？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Maintenance?  Now?  Looks like some things have not changed in 5 billion years...  I'll get right to work on taking out this Inhibitor while you perform 'maintenance' on your gel circuits.
strings.zh: 维护？现在？看来有些事过了五十亿年也没变……你去给你的凝胶回路做「维护」，我这就动手干掉这个抑制器。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: What's up Creeper World Commanders? This is my very first map I made. This map was created in one of the first builds, it has been remastered for your pleasure. Enjoy, and thanks for playing!
strings.zh: Creeper World的指挥官们，近来可好？这是我最开始做的第一张地图。它诞生于最早期的某个版本，如今为了诸位重新打磨过。玩得开心，感谢试玩！
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: This is a testing simulator of a little game where you have to move the green walls in such a way that they will survive as long as possible. Arrow keys to move. The game will end in 10 minutes. Good luck!
strings.zh: 这是一个小游戏的测试模拟器：你要移动绿色墙壁，让它们尽可能活得久一些。用方向键移动。游戏将在10分钟后结束。祝你好运！
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: This has to be a Ticon world....
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: It once was, but the technology here is different and not exactly Ticon in origin.  It's more recent and seems to be in perfect working order.
strings.zh: 它曾经是。但这里的科技不一样，来源并不完全是泰肯。它更晚近，而且看起来运转得完好无损。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Perhaps a later civilization updated it and kept it working.
strings.zh: 也许是后来的某个文明把它升级过，一直维持着运转。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: That could have been true.  But Skars, this equipment seems to have been built very recently.  Perhaps in the last 100 years.  The last human civilization has been gone far longer than that.
strings.zh: 本来可以这么想。可是斯卡斯，这套设备看起来是最近才建成的，也许就在这一百年之内。最后的人类文明消失得比那久远得多。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: There appear to be three Power centers, those blocky structures.  Each is connected via a power conduit to three parts of a central station.  My guess is all three parts have to be active for it to function.
strings.zh: 看起来有三座能源中心，就是那些方块状的结构。每一座都通过能量导管，连到中央站点的三个部分。我猜三个部分都得激活，它才能运作。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: And how do we bring the Power Centers online?
strings.zh: 那怎么让能源中心上线？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Scans show they are in pristine condition and not being damaged by the Creeper.  If they work via the same technology as Fractal Collectors, it may be as simple as clearing out all of the Creeper from around each Power Center.
strings.zh: 扫描显示它们完好无损，也没有被Creeper侵蚀。如果它们和分形收集器用的是同一套技术，那也许只要清掉每座能源中心周围的Creeper就行。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: And that should activate the central station... the thing we don't know anything about.
strings.zh: 然后中央站点就会启动……那个我们一无所知的东西。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Yes.  I can say that even though this equipment is new and in perfect condition, it does not appear to be much more than some sort of testing facility.  The power produced by those Power Centers just isn't enough to do too much damage, regardless of what it actually does.
strings.zh: 是的。我可以说，这套设备虽然新、状态又完美，但看起来不过是个试验设施。不管它究竟做什么，那几座能源中心产生的能量，都不足以造成太大的破坏。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: That's encouraging... I think.  Well, let's flip the switch on this thing and see what happens.
strings.zh: 这话真让人安心……大概吧。行，那我们就合上这个开关，看看会怎么样。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I don't know if this is good or bad.
strings.zh: 我不知道这是好事还是坏事。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: More ancient historical volumes... more references to the "Arc"?
strings.zh: 又是古老的历史典籍……又提到「弧」？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I've never seen this form of data encoding before, it is very complex.... nearly perfect and recorded at an atomic scale with incredible fault tolerance.  But, I can still resolve most of the content and translate it.
strings.zh: 我从没见过这种数据编码，它极其复杂……近乎完美，以原子尺度记录，容错能力强得不可思议。不过，我仍然能解析出大部分内容，并把它翻译出来。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: It seems to be a technical specification for the field device on this world.  I was right, this tech was a test for a part of a device being constructed elsewhere.
strings.zh: 它似乎是这个世界那台场装置的技术规格书。我说对了，这项技术是为了测试某个正在别处建造的装置的一个部件。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: And who built this equipment and recorded the message?
strings.zh: 那这套设备是谁建的？信息又是谁录的？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Skars, the designator that appears within the contents appears to translate to; "16th Transient Regiment, 4th Ephemeral Division, Loki Hive".
strings.zh: 斯卡斯，内容里出现的番号，翻译过来似乎是：「第16瞬变团，第4蜉蝣师，洛基巢穴」。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en:
My Gods... the Loki are here.  

Now, I know my purpose.
strings.zh:
我的神啊……洛基就在这里。

现在，我知道我的使命了。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: You aren't serious about that plan, are you?
strings.zh: 那个计划……你不是认真的吧？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Don't get offensive, if you know any better plan that is doable in our time shedule, i'm fine hearing it.
strings.zh: 别动气。你要是知道更好的方案，而且能在我们的时间表内做成，我很乐意听。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en:
(Several Hours later)
Our ultimate weapons aren't in shape to fight the enemy directly... he is too strong for taht either. 
We need to get our ranged weapon going.
strings.zh:
（数小时后）
我们那些终极武器还没到能和敌人正面硬碰的状态……他太强了，硬碰也赢不了。
得让我们的远程武器动起来。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en:
7 Minutes until 00.00.
Let Operation Yashima begin.
strings.zh:
距离00.00还有7分钟。
开始「屋岛作战」。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en:
(Note: The Enemy Spore Towers will, after they finished building, throw insane amounts of spores at you (10 Spores every 2.5 Seconds)
It's very recommended to build overbuild Beams)
strings.zh:
（注：敌方的孢子塔建成之后，会向你抛出疯狂数量的孢子（每2.5秒10颗孢子）
非常建议多造、多堆光束）
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: This place once was knows as tucana. Power up all totems and you'll win.
strings.zh: 这里曾被称为图卡纳。给所有图腾供能，你就赢了。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Are you going to let the Creeper push you around?
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I didn't notice that object on the scanners till we got closer...  so I've emergency steered the ship to a counter orbit away from the proto-Magnetar.
strings.zh: 直到我们靠近，我才在扫描仪上注意到那个物体……所以我紧急把飞船转向，改到一个远离原磁星的逆向轨道。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: That red orb in orbit around this world?  It seems to have a massive gravitational and magnetic field.
strings.zh: 环绕这颗星球的那个红色球体？它似乎有极其巨大的引力场和磁场。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: It's a piece of a left over magnetar... an artificial magnetar at that.  It was used in an attempt to construct a Dyson sphere around this system.  Which in turn was another failed attempt to hide from the Creeper.
strings.zh: 它是一颗残留磁星的碎片……而且是人工磁星。它曾被用来在这个星系周围建造戴森球。那又是一次躲避Creeper的失败尝试。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: It's effect on the Creeper should be of concern.  Creeper is attracted by its intense gravitational field, so it should flow toward the Magnetar.  But the Magnetar is orbiting the world...
strings.zh: 它对Creeper的影响值得警惕。Creeper会被它强烈的引力场吸引，因此会朝磁星流动。可磁星正在环绕这颗星球运行……
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: So there will be a massive Creeper tide from helheim... that's what you are saying.
strings.zh: 所以会有一场来自海尔海姆的Creeper巨潮……你是这个意思。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Yes, in short that is correct.  The good news is that you can use the fully available tech upgrades to help deal with the uncertain situation on the ground.
strings.zh: 是的，简而言之就是这样。好消息是，你可以用完全解锁的技术升级，来应对地面上不确定的局势。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Also... proximity to the Magnetar has allowed me to enable a special ability on the Forge.  Rather than just being used for special upgrades, the forge can now attempt to activate the Totems and open a portal to Rift Space.
strings.zh: 另外……靠近磁星让我得以在锻造厂上启用一项特殊能力。锻造厂如今不再只用于特殊升级，它还能尝试激活图腾，打开通往裂隙空间的传送门。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: But you said Rift Space was destroyed.
strings.zh: 可你说过裂隙空间已经毁了。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Indeed it was.  But the attempt to open Rift Space will create a temporary opening to a realm of immense gravity.  This 'Singularity Weapon' is accessible from the Forge menu.  Be cautious, though, it uses immense amounts of Aether.
strings.zh: 确实毁了。但尝试打开裂隙空间，会造出一个通往极强重力领域的临时开口。这件「奇点武器」可以从锻造厂菜单使用。不过要小心，它消耗的以太极其惊人。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.zh: 你先前顺口提到了「瓦罗」。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: This Message Artifact appears to have been written by 'Varro Hale' who lived in your time.  The message says he was friends with 'Dax Joven' and went on to head the Command Academy on Colony Prime among other minor historical facts.
strings.zh: 这件信息圣物似乎是你那个时代的「瓦罗·黑尔」所写。信息里提到他与「达克斯·乔文」是朋友，后来还执掌了殖民地首星上的指挥学院，此外还有些零碎史实。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Yes!  Colony Prime... it seems like I just left there Lia...  Without Dax and Varro, we would never have rebuilt humanity... nothing that came after would have been possible.
strings.zh: 是的！殖民地首星……感觉我才刚从那儿离开，莉娅……没有达克斯和瓦罗，我们永远重建不了人类……后来的一切都不可能存在。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: That is certainly correct, Skars.  If you and the others had failed there would not have been the thousands of civilizations and trillions of lives that followed.  They all owe you and the others a debt of gratitude.
strings.zh: 确实如此，斯卡斯。如果你和其他人当年失败了，就不会有后来成千上万的文明和数以万亿计的生命。他们都欠你和那些人一份感激。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Debt? It was all for nothing Lia.  NOTHING!  Everything is gone.
strings.zh: 感激？这一切都白费了，莉娅。全白费了！一切都消失了。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Anything else in the message recoverable other than Varro's curriculum vitae?
strings.zh: 除了瓦罗的履历，信息里还有别的东西能恢复吗？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Just one fragment; It reads, "... and without the tutelage, guidance, and guile of Admiral Skarsgard Abraxis, we never would have eventually discovered Aliana's true gifts".
strings.zh: 只有一段残片，上面写着：「……若无斯卡斯加德·阿布拉克斯将军的教导、指引与谋略，我们终究无法发现阿利安娜真正的天赋」。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Aliana's true gifts?  What does that mean?  Aliana, my daughter???
strings.zh: 阿利安娜真正的天赋？那是什么意思？阿利安娜，我的女儿？？？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Lia, this world seems familiar.  I recognize that central structure and the surrounding stations.
strings.zh: 莉娅，这个世界看着眼熟。那座中央结构和周围的站点，我都认得。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I... I'm not sure.  Are there any signs of the Loki?  Perhaps this is their doing and all some sort of deception?
strings.zh: 我……我不确定。有洛基的踪迹吗？也许这是他们干的，全是一场骗局？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Nothing, Skars.  Nothing at all.  After everything we have been though, all I detect are cold machines.  But, machines with a purpose I now clearly understand.
strings.zh: 没有，斯卡斯。什么都没有。经历了这一切之后，我能探测到的只有冰冷的机器。可是……这些机器的用途，我现在看得很清楚了。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: You see it too, then.  These six stations are receiving incomprehensible amounts of data from across the universe, and they are feeding it to a central core.
strings.zh: 那你也看出来了。这六座站点正在从宇宙各处接收难以想象的海量数据，再把它们输送给中央核心。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I just do, Lia.  I see things now....  That central core is constructing what the Seloi called the 'Arc Eternal', and the Loki were right to react to knowledge of it.
strings.zh: 我就是知道，莉娅。我现在能看见东西了……那座中央核心正在建造塞洛伊人所说的「永恒之弧」，而洛基一听到它的消息就做出那样的反应，是对的。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Yes, from all that I have learned I see this as well.  But I still don't fully understand the purpose of the Arc.
strings.zh: 是的，从我了解到的一切来看，我也看出了这一点。但我仍然没有完全弄清永恒之弧的目的。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The Arc is a universal singleton, Lia.  Something of which only one may exist.  There can be no other, and once made it cannot be unmade.  The Arc forms an absolute reference point across all of space, time, and alternate eventualities.
strings.zh: 永恒之弧是宇宙中的唯一体，莉娅。这种东西只可能存在一个。不可能有第二个，而一旦成形，就再也无法抹除。永恒之弧构成了一个横跨所有空间、时间与平行可能性的绝对参照点。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: How is such a thing possible?  How is such a thing even possible to construct... and how do you...?
strings.zh: 这怎么可能？这种东西怎么可能被建造出来……还有，你怎么会……？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: It isn't being constructed, it is simply being revealed.  It exists through all of space and time for this universe, Lia.  Once revealed, it will provide access to any time, any location, even alternate eventualities.
strings.zh: 它不是被建造出来的，它只是被揭示出来。对这个宇宙而言，它贯穿全部空间与时间，莉娅。一旦被揭示，它就能打开通往任何时间、任何地点、甚至平行可能性的通道。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Every decision, every decay of every subatomic particle, every choice, every random event spread across the entire history of the universe are all mapped to a fabric.  That fabric has its origin in the Arc.
strings.zh: 每一个决定，每一个亚原子粒子的每一次衰变，每一次抉择，宇宙全史上散布的每一桩随机事件，都映射在一张织锦之上。而那张织锦的源头，就在永恒之弧。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: To reveal the Arc requires knowledge of a massive amount of space and time.  Don't you see Lia?  Don't you see now?
strings.zh: 要揭示永恒之弧，需要关于海量空间与时间的知识。你还不明白吗，莉娅？现在你还不明白吗？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: I...  how do you know all of this Skars?
strings.zh: 我……这些你怎么会全都知道，斯卡斯？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: The Creeper's purpose wasn't simply to destroy, it was to record.  It collected knowledge of everything it touched and it remembered.  Trillions and trillions of worlds covered with Creeper across billions of years, harvesting information...  Can't you see how elegant and beautiful that was, Lia?
strings.zh: Creeper的目的不只是毁灭，而是记录。它收集自己触及的一切知识，然后记住。亿万年之间，数万亿又数万亿个被Creeper覆盖的世界，在收割信息……你难道看不出那有多么优雅、多么美吗，莉娅？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）
剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Humans and their many civilizations were a bounty of complexity.  An ever renewing fountain of information.... but there were many others in many other galaxies.  Now, all of that knowledge will finally allow the Loki to pinpoint and reveal the Arc Eternal.
strings.zh: 人类和他们的众多文明，是复杂性的丰饶馈赠。一座永远更新的信息之泉……但还有许多其他星系里的其他文明。现在，所有这些知识终将让洛基定位并揭示永恒之弧。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: And we should stop this, Skars.... Right?
strings.zh: 而我们该阻止这件事，斯卡斯……对吧？
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: Yes.... yes, of course.  Access to the Arc would allow the Loki total mastery of everything.  They could rewrite the course of events in this universe.  This must be prevented.
strings.zh: 是的……是的，当然。掌握永恒之弧，洛基就能彻底支配一切。他们能改写这个宇宙的事件进程。必须阻止。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: From what I can determine, it should be as simple as taking those six stations offline.  They are processing incoming Aether beams using a technology that I don't understand.  But, their power source is simple... they need Creeper to function.
strings.zh: 据我判断，只要让那六座站点离线就行，就这么简单。它们在用一种我不理解的技术处理来袭的以太光束。但它们的能量来源很简单……它们需要Creeper才能运转。
strings.note: 剧情台词（resources.assets TextAsset / LZMA XML <m>）

strings.en: So, clear away the Creeper from the stations and they go offline.  That will buy us some time, then we can destroy those stations with nullifiers and prevent the Loki from revealing the Arc.
strings.zh: 那么，把站点周围的Creeper清掉，它们就会离线。这样能给我们争取一些时间，然后我们就能用灭除器摧毁那些站点，阻止洛基揭示永恒之弧。

strings.en:
Select a Command Node from the menu below and land it
in the gray area in the upper left corner of the map.

***NOTE*** If necessary, you may move the map with:
RIGHT MOUSE, ARROW KEYS, or WASD keys.
 You may zoom the map with: MOUSE WHEEL or Q and Z keys.
strings.zh:
从下方菜单选择一个指挥节点，把它降落在
地图左上角的灰色区域。

***注意***如有必要，你可以用以下方式移动地图：
鼠标右键、方向键或WASD键。
 你可以用以下方式缩放地图：鼠标滚轮或Q和Z键。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
Excellent.
Now build collectors and connect them to the Command Node.
Spread them out for maximum energy collection.
The more green you see, the more energy you produce.
BUILD 10 COLLECTORS.
strings.zh:
很好。
现在建造收集器，并把它们连接到指挥节点。
把它们分散开来，以获得最大的能量收集。
你看到的绿色越多，产生的能量就越多。
建造10个收集器。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
Weapons are required for destroying the Creeper.
Be careful to not overbuild and exceed your energy production.
Build 3 Pulse Cannons now.
strings.zh:
摧毁Creeper需要武器。
小心不要建造过多而超出你的能量产出。
现在建造3门脉冲炮。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
Impressive.
Now, spread your network and defeat the blue Creeper Emitter.
You will need to build a Nullifier near the emitter to destroy it.
Also, don't forget to connect your network to the pod behind the emitter.
strings.zh:
令人印象深刻。
现在，扩张你的网络，击败那个蓝色Creeper发射器。
你需要在发射器附近建造一个灭除器来摧毁它。
另外，别忘了把你的网络连接到发射器后面的科技舱。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
Move your Pulse Cannons in close to the Creeper and surround it.
 Make sure they remain connected to your network
so they can be resupplied with ammo.
When possible build a nullifier near the emitter to destroy it!
strings.zh:
把你的脉冲炮移近Creeper，并把它包围起来。
 确保它们始终与你的网络保持连接
这样它们才能得到弹药补给。
有机会时，在发射器附近建造灭除器把它摧毁！
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en: Now, build your network close to the Pod to collect it.
strings.zh: 现在，把你的网络建到科技舱旁边，以便收集它。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en: Defeat the Emitter with a Nullifier to complete the mission.
strings.zh: 用灭除器击败发射器，完成任务。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
Build a Nullifier near the blue emitter.
Move the map with RIGHT MOUSE, ARROW KEYS, or WASD keys.
 Zoom with MOUSE WHEEL or Q and Z keys.
strings.zh:
在蓝色发射器附近建造灭除器。
用鼠标右键、方向键或WASD键移动地图。
 用鼠标滚轮或Q和Z键缩放。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en: The right emitter emits creeper proportional to your ore mined
strings.zh: 右侧发射器喷出的Creeper与你开采的矿石量成正比
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
Strafers are remote strike aircraft.
Build 4 strafers and target two at each volcano.
Single click to create a circle strafe attack pattern.
Click and drag to define a strafe line of attack.
strings.zh:
俯冲机是远程打击飞行器。
建造4架俯冲机，每座火山派两架。
单击可创建环形俯冲攻击路线。
点击并拖动可定义一条直线俯冲攻击线。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en: Remember to build a lot of beams and reactors!
strings.zh: 记得多建光束和反应堆！
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
Bombers are aircraft that deliver AntiCreeper.
Build Bombers to saturate remote islands.
Make sure to collect plenty of Ore!
strings.zh:
轰炸机是投送Anti-Creeper的飞行器。
建造轰炸机，用Anti-Creeper灌满远处的岛屿。
一定要开采充足的矿石！
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
Select a Command Node from the menu below
 and land it in the indicated gray area.
strings.zh:
从下方菜单选择一个指挥节点，
 把它降落在标出的灰色区域。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
Build a collector near the green Tech Artifact to obtain it.
This will unlock the Relay tech. Relays can be used for making
long range connections but do not produce energy like collectors.
strings.zh:
在绿色科技圣物旁建造一个收集器来取得它。
这将解锁中继器技术。中继器可用于建立
长距离连接，但不像收集器那样产生能量。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
Expand your network and build weapons to engage the Creeper.
Your target is the large Warp Inhibitor in the lower right.
Build a nullifier near it to take it out.
strings.zh:
扩张网络并建造武器，向Creeper发起攻击。
你的目标是右下方那座大型跃迁抑制器。
在它附近建造灭除器把它摧毁。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
Build a Nullifier near the Warp Inhibitor to destroy it!
Destroying the Inhibitor will destroy other enemies on the map!
strings.zh:
在跃迁抑制器附近建造灭除器来摧毁它！
摧毁抑制器会连带消灭地图上的其他敌人！
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
Collect the Beam Tech Artifact.
Place Beams around your base to defend against Spore attacks.
strings.zh:
收集光束科技圣物。
在基地周围布置光束，防御孢子攻击。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）
关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en: Land on the right side of the map and collect the Tech Artifact.
strings.zh: 降落到地图右侧，收集科技圣物。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
You can now deploy a second Command Node onto the battlefield.
Click the Orbital tab and select the second Command Node.
Land it on the other side of the map.
strings.zh:
现在你可以向战场投放第二个指挥节点。
点击轨道页，选择第二个指挥节点。
把它降落到地图的另一侧。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
Take out the two emitters sourcing the Digitalis.
The ultimate goal is to destroy the Inhibitor in the center of the map.
strings.zh:
消灭为魔苋供能的两个发射器。
最终目标是摧毁地图中央的抑制器。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
You can hide the white Digitalis growth area by pressing
the Visibility Button, then unchecking 'Show D-Growth'.
strings.zh:
按下可见性按钮，然后取消勾选「显示魔苋生长」，
即可隐藏白色的魔苋生长区域。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
Build Siphons on the Resource Packs.
The Green Crystals will give you energy in this map.
On other maps, other resources may be available.
strings.zh:
在资源包上建造虹吸器。
在这张地图上，绿色晶体能为你提供能量。
在其他地图上，可能会有别的资源。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
Build Terps to terraform land.
Build around 5 terps now.
Spread them around near the edge of the old ruins.
strings.zh:
建造挖掘机来改造地形。
现在建造5台左右的挖掘机。
把它们分散布置在古老废墟的边缘附近。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
Click the Terraform Button then paint where to change the terrain.
Nearby Terps will automatically act on nearby terrain.
Select a brush size of 1, and a terrain height of 9.
Fill in the gaps in the ruin walls and watch the Terps terraform the land.
strings.zh:
点击地形改造按钮，然后涂抹想要改造的地形。
附近的挖掘机将自动对附近的地形施工。
选择笔刷大小1、地形高度9。
把废墟墙壁上的缺口填满，看挖掘机改造这片土地。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）
关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）
关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）
关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
Each train is marked by the number of its destination.
Your goal is to route each train to its proper
goal while avoiding various kinds of accidents.
strings.zh:
每列列车都标有它目的地的编号。
你的目标是把每列列车引导到正确的
站点，同时避免各种事故。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
The trains travel on a system of terrain level 8 rails.
The switches work by raising or lowering portions of track.
strings.zh:
列车行驶在一套地形等级8的轨道系统上。
道岔的工作原理是抬升或降低某段轨道。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en: Watch while I move the switches to direct the train to station #5.
strings.zh: 看着我把道岔切换，把这列列车引到5号站。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en: If the train arrives in the right place, your score goes up by 1.
strings.zh: 如果列车到达正确的地点，你的得分会增加1分。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
Unfortunately, your trains won't always arrive at the correct places.
There are several ways in which this may happen, which I will explain.
First, your trains may derail if the switches are improperly managed.
strings.zh:
不幸的是，你的列车并不总能到达正确的位置。
出现这种情况有几种原因，我来逐一说明。
首先，如果道岔管理不当，你的列车可能会脱轨。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en: If one of your trains has no more track to run on, it will derail.
strings.zh: 如果某列列车前方没有轨道可走，它就会脱轨。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en: If the train derails, your score goes down by 5 points.
strings.zh: 如果列车脱轨，你的得分会减少5分。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
As you can see, a derailment does more than cost you 5 points. It
also disrupts the area, and destroys more tracks. These damaged tracks
may cause chain reactions of derailments, so you should fix them like this.
strings.zh:
如你所见，脱轨不只是让你损失5分。它
还会破坏周边区域，并摧毁更多轨道。这些受损的轨道
可能引发连锁脱轨，所以你应该像这样修复它们。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
Another way that you can lose points is by sending trains
to the wrong stations. If a train arrives at the wrong station,
you will lose 2 points.
strings.zh:
另一种失分的方式是把列车送到
错误的车站。如果列车到达错误的车站，
你会损失2分。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
The trains that come from the station are semi-random. After one
train is sent, the system will wait a short time before preparing
the next one to be sent to a random destination on the map.
strings.zh:
从车站出发的列车目标是半随机的。一列
列车发出后，系统会等待一小段时间，再准备
下一列，把它发往地图上随机的目的地。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
During the game, your current score, as well as the time until the next
train are displayed in the upper-right hand corner. You have 3 minutes to
set up your terps before the first train. You win when your score is 100
strings.zh:
游戏过程中，你当前的得分，以及距离下一班
列车的时间，都会显示在右上角。你有3分钟时间
在第一班列车到来前布置好挖掘机。得分达到100时你就获胜。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）
关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）
关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
YOU LOSE! So maybe running a railroad just isn't your
thing, but least there's other things you can do, like
under-creeper basket weaving, perhaps. Play again soon!
strings.zh:
你输了！看来经营铁路也许不是你的
强项，不过至少你还能做点别的，比如
在Creeper底下编编篮子？很快就再来玩吧！
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
Shield Keys and other Artifacts must be connected
to a Command Node to be collected.
Guppies can not collect them.
strings.zh:
护盾钥匙和其他圣物必须连接到
指挥节点才能被收集。
补给船无法收集它们。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en: Collect the Reactor Tech Artifact at the bottom of the map.
strings.zh: 收集地图底部的反应堆科技圣物。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
Reactors produce energy like collectors, but can be tightly packed.
You will need to build around 10 Reactors for this mission.
Build only a couple at a time till your energy production increases.
strings.zh:
反应堆像收集器一样产生能量，但可以紧密堆叠。
本任务中你需要建造10座左右反应堆。
每次只建两三座，直到你的能量产出提升。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
Power Zones are left when you destroy enemies.
Move units onto the glowing circular Power Zones to get extra abilities.
strings.zh:
消灭敌人后会留下供能区。
把单位移动到发光的圆形供能区上，即可获得额外能力。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en: Now defeat all emitters to secure this world.
strings.zh: 现在击败所有发射器，拿下这颗星球。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
NOTE*** If necessary, you may move the map with:
RIGHT MOUSE, ARROW KEYS, or WASD keys.
 You may zoom the map with: MOUSE WHEEL or Q and Z keys.
strings.zh:
注意***如有必要，你可以用以下方式移动地图：
鼠标右键、方向键或WASD键。
 你可以用以下方式缩放地图：鼠标滚轮或Q和Z键。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
Build Ore Mines on the Ore Deposits to collect ore.
Ore can be used to make Anti-Creeper.
Anti-Creeper destroys Creeper on contact.
strings.zh:
在矿床建造矿场来开采矿石。
矿石可用于制造Anti-Creeper。
Anti-Creeper一接触就会摧毁Creeper。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
Build Sprayers to make Anti-Creeper.
Deploy sprayers near Creeper and they will fire blobs into the Creeper.
This can be useful for securing a beachhead.
strings.zh:
建造喷吐者来制造Anti-Creeper。
把喷吐者部署在Creeper附近，它们会向Creeper发射弹团。
这对建立登陆立足点很有用。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en: Remember, you only need to destroy the Inhibitor to secure this world!
strings.zh: 记住，你只需要摧毁抑制器就能拿下这颗星球！
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
Each train is marked by the number of its destination.
Your goal is to route each train to its proper
goal while avoiding various kinds of accidents.
strings.zh:
每列列车都标有它目的地的编号。
你的目标是把每列列车引导到正确的
站点，同时避免各种事故。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
The trains travel on a system of terrain level 8 rails.
The switches work by raising or lowering portions of track.
Press the escape key now to skip the tutorial.
strings.zh:
列车行驶在一套地形等级8的轨道系统上。
道岔的工作原理是抬升或降低某段轨道。
现在按Esc键可以跳过教程。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
Unfortunately, your trains won't always arrive at the correct places.
There are several ways in which this may happen, which I will explain.
First, your trains may derail if the switches are improperly managed.
strings.zh:
不幸的是，你的列车并不总能到达正确的位置。
出现这种情况有几种原因，我来逐一说明。
首先，如果道岔管理不当，你的列车可能会脱轨。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
As you can see, a derailment does more than cost you 5 points. It
also disrupts the area, and destroys more tracks. These damaged tracks
may cause chain reactions of derailments, so you should fix them like this.
strings.zh:
如你所见，脱轨不只是让你损失5分。它
还会破坏周边区域，并摧毁更多轨道。这些受损的轨道
可能引发连锁脱轨，所以你应该像这样修复它们。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
Another way that you can lose points is by sending trains
to the wrong stations. If a train arrives at the wrong station,
you will lose 2 points.
strings.zh:
另一种失分的方式是把列车送到
错误的车站。如果列车到达错误的车站，
你会损失2分。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
The trains that come from the station have random targets. After one
train is sent, the system will wait a short time before preparing
the next one to be sent to a random destination on the map.
strings.zh:
从车站出发的列车目标都是随机的。一列
列车发出后，系统会等待一小段时间，再准备
下一列，把它发往地图上随机的目的地。
strings.note: 关卡内嵌 CRPL ShowMessage 文案（15 关 67 条）

strings.en:
During the game, your current score, as well as the time until the next
train are displayed in the upper-right hand corner. You have 3 minutes to
set up your terps before the first train. You win when your score is 100
strings.zh:
游戏过程中，你当前的得分，以及距离下一班
列车的时间，都会显示在右上角。你有3分钟时间
在第一班列车到来前布置好挖掘机。得分达到100时你就获胜。

需要闭合哪些开关才能点亮这盏灯？
	A：只有A     B：只有B     C：都不用     D：两个都要

All lamps are same

所有灯都一样

现在你可以跳过题目

strings.zh:
在下一题中，你要选出一个能装进这个装置的元件
	有四个可能答案，它们列在字母下方
	如果有多个答案成立，你必须把它们全选上

	If you destroyed the collector on pad A destroy the reset collector
	For this 'question' your penalty won't increase so you can try it out

所以如果A是正确答案，你就摧毁B台上的收集器
	然后再摧毁「继续」上的收集器
	如果你摧毁了A台上的收集器，就摧毁那个重置收集器

	The penalty increases with one seconds each time

	如果答案错了，你会被罚4秒
	并且必须重试
	每次罚时都会再加1秒

	Why? There are questions with multuple good answers and

strings.zh:
摧毁除正确答案之外的所有收集器
	摧毁「重置」台上的收集器可以恢复所有收集器
	为什么？因为有些题有多个正确答案，而且
	你可以把错误的答案划掉

strings.en:
Mortars damage creeper that is deep.
Move several mortars around each crater
and they will suppress the creeper.
strings.zh:
迫击炮能打伤深处的Creeper。
在每个弹坑周围摆几门迫击炮，
就能把Creeper压制下去。

屏幕右下角指挥栏里的地形计
会显示鼠标所在处的地形高度和Creeper水位。
